  describe("the deleters take their rows in id order", () => {
    /** A post with two images whose position order is the reverse of their id order. */
    async function reversedImages(db: Db) {
      const owner = await profile(db);
      const postId = await newPostRow(db, owner.id);
      const [low, high] = sorted([randomUUID(), randomUUID()]) as [string, string];
      // The higher id is created first and stands first on the post.
      for (const [position, id] of [high, low].entries()) {
        await db.execute(sql`insert into post_media (id, owner_id, status, width, height, blurhash, created_at) values (${id}::uuid, ${owner.id}::uuid, 'ready', 1200, 800, 'L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL', now() - ${`${10 - position} minutes`}::interval)`);
        await db.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${postId}::uuid, position = ${position}, alt_text = ${`image ${position + 1}`} where id = ${id}::uuid`);
      }
      return { ownerId: owner.id, postId, low, high };
    }
    /** Whether another session could lock the row now: false while a transaction that updated, deleted or locked it holds it. */
    const free = async (table: "post_media" | "posts", id: string) => (await apiDb.execute(sql`select id from ${sql.raw(table)} where id = ${id}::uuid for share skip locked`)).length === 1;

    test.each([
      ["detachAll", "where post_id = "],
      ["purgeOwner", "where owner_id = "],
    ] as const)("%s waits at the row with the lowest id and has taken no other meanwhile, though that row stands second on the post", async (method, marker) => {
      const { ownerId, postId, low, high } = await reversedImages(apiDb);
      const [held, wait] = [gate(), gate()];
      let holding: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
      let deleting: Promise<string[]> = Promise.resolve([]);
      try {
        // Another transaction holds the row with the lowest id, as an intake does that reaches it.
        holding = withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`select id from post_media where id = ${low}::uuid for key share`);
          held.open();
          await wait.opened;
        });
        await Promise.race([held.opened, holding]);
        deleting = withLockTimeout(apiDb, (tx) => (method === "detachAll" ? repoOn(tx).detachAll(tx, postId) : repoOn(tx).purgeOwner(tx, ownerId)));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
        // A delete in the order of the post's positions would have taken the higher id first and hold it now.
        expect(await free("post_media", high)).toBe(true);
        wait.open();
        await holding;
        expect(sorted(await deleting)).toEqual([low, high]);
        expect(await existing(apiDb, [low, high])).toEqual([]);
      } finally {
        wait.open();
        await Promise.allSettled([holding, deleting]);
        await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [ownerId]);
      }
    });

    test("purgeProfile takes the account's posts in id order: it waits at the post with the lowest id and has taken no other meanwhile", async () => {
      const owner = await profile(apiDb);
      // Three posts; the one with the lowest id is neither the first nor the last by creation time, nor the first stored.
      const ids = sorted([randomUUID(), randomUUID(), randomUUID()]) as [string, string, string];
      const [low, middle, high] = ids;
      for (const [id, age] of [[middle, "3 days"], [low, "2 days"], [high, "1 day"]] as const) {
        await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into posts (id, author_id, body, created_at) values (${id}::uuid, ${owner.id}::uuid, 'a post', now() - interval '30 days' - ${age}::interval)`);
      }
      const [held, wait] = [gate(), gate()];
      let holding: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
      let purging: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
      try {
        // An intake holds a post for share while it copies it, lowest id first.
        holding = withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`select id from posts where id = ${low}::uuid for share`);
          held.open();
          await wait.opened;
        });
        await Promise.race([held.opened, holding]);
        purging = createSocialRepo(apiDb).purgeProfile(owner.id, new Date(), async () => undefined);
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "order by id for update");
        expect([await free("posts", middle), await free("posts", high)]).toEqual([true, true]);
        wait.open();
        await holding;
        await purging;
        const states = await apiDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select state from posts where id = any(${uuids(ids)})`);
        expect(states.map((row) => row.state)).toEqual(["deleted_by_author", "deleted_by_author", "deleted_by_author"]);
      } finally {
        wait.open();
        await Promise.allSettled([holding, purging]);
        await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [owner.id]);
      }
    });

    /**
     * The two shapes in which a report holds two posts of one account that the purge's counters write: a post that quotes
     * its author's own post brings the quoted post as a target the module adds, and the report copies the two in id order.
     * In the first the quoting post has the lower id and the purge's quote counter writes the other one. In the second the
     * quoted post has the lower id and its author has deleted it: the purge tombstones only the quoting post, and its
     * counter still writes the deleted one.
     */
    const SHAPES = ["the quoting post has the lower id", "the quoted post has the lower id and was deleted by its author"] as const;
    /** An account with a post that quotes its own earlier post, an image on each, committed; `first` is the post a report copies first. */
    async function selfQuote(shape: (typeof SHAPES)[number]) {
      const owner = await profile(apiDb);
      const [low, high] = sorted([randomUUID(), randomUUID()]) as [string, string];
      const [quoting, quoted] = shape === SHAPES[0] ? [low, high] : [high, low];
      await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into posts (id, author_id, body, quote_count, created_at) values (${quoted}::uuid, ${owner.id}::uuid, 'the quoted post', 1, now() - interval '31 days')`);
      await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into posts (id, author_id, body, quote_of_id, created_at) values (${quoting}::uuid, ${owner.id}::uuid, 'a post that quotes its author', ${quoted}::uuid, now() - interval '30 days')`);
      const images = [await newImageRow(apiDb, owner.id, quoting, 0), await newImageRow(apiDb, owner.id, quoted, 0)];
      // The deleted post keeps its image row here, as a hold or a freeze would have kept it.
      if (shape === SHAPES[1]) await authorDeletes(apiDb, quoted);
      return { owner, quoting, quoted, first: low, second: high, images };
    }
    const postsOf = async (ids: readonly string[]) =>
      (await apiDb.execute<{ id: string; state: string; quote_count: number }>(sql`select id, state, quote_count from posts where id = any(${uuids(ids)}) order by id`)).map((row) => ({ ...row }));

    test.each(SHAPES)("a post that quotes its author's own post, %s; the notice holding first: the purge waits at the first post having locked neither, and no deadlock follows", async (shape) => {
      const f = await selfQuote(shape);
      const [held, wait] = [gate(), gate()];
      let reporting: Promise<number> = Promise.resolve(0);
      let purging: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
      let answered: string[] | null = null;
      try {
        // The notice names the quoting post and the module adds the post it quotes. It copies its posts in id order and
        // is stopped here between the two, holding the first for share.
        reporting = withLockTimeout(apiDb, (tx) =>
          intakeRuns(tx, ground.csam(), [aPost(f.quoting)], async (postId) => {
            if (postId !== f.first) return;
            held.open();
            await wait.opened;
          }),
        );
        await Promise.race([held.opened, reporting]);

type Role = { is: "deleter" } | { is: "reader" } | { is: "neither"; why: string };
const METHODS: Record<keyof MediaRepo, Role> = {
  accountCreatedAt: { is: "neither", why: "reads when an account was onboarded, and no image row" },

  insertProcessing: { is: "neither", why: "inserts an upload on no post" },

    };
    const exported = (id: string): AccountExport => ({
      account: { id, email: "owner@korbat.local", createdAt: new Date(), role: "user", mfaEnabled: false, hasPassword: false, verified: false, termsVersion: null, termsAcceptedAt: null },
      passkeys: [],
      sessions: [],
      devices: [],
      events: [],
    });
    return {
      finished,
      auth: {
        startDeletion: notHere,
        confirmDeletion: notHere,
        pendingPurges: async () => pending,
        finishPurge: async (userId) => void finished.push(userId),
        exportAccount: async (userId) => exported(userId),
        appendEvent: async () => undefined,
      },
      social: { purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) => w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, within), exportProfile: (userId, pageSize) => exportProfile(w.s.deps, userId, pageSize) },
      media: mediaForAccount(w.h.deps),
      limits: new MemoryStore(),
      log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
      now: () => new Date(),
    };
  }
  /** The account's whole export as its archive holds it: the entries' names, and export.json. */
  async function exportOf(w: World, userId: string) {
    const plan = await buildExport(accountDeps(w), userId, "the-asking-session", new Date());
    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
    await writeExport(createZipWriter(async (chunk) => void chunks.push(Uint8Array.from(chunk))), plan);
    const files = unzipSync(Buffer.concat(chunks));
    const json = JSON.parse(strFromU8(files["export.json"]!)) as { posts: { id: string; body: string; state: string; media: { id: string; file: string; altText: string }[] }[]; missingMedia: string[] };
    return { entries: Object.keys(files).sort(), json };
  }

  describe("the record over the repository's methods", () => {
    test("names every method createMediaRepo has, and no other", () => {
      expect(Object.keys(createMediaRepo(apiDb)).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(METHODS).sort());
    });

    test("every deleter has a run against a frozen post, and every method that does neither says why", () => {
      expect(Object.keys(DELETERS).sort()).toEqual(methodsThatAre("deleter"));
      expect(methodsThatAre("deleter")).toEqual(["deleteRow", "deleteUnattached", "deleteUnattachedBefore", "detachAll", "dropDisposable", "purgeOwner"]);
      // The readers are run through what calls them: serve (fileAccess), the lists (forPosts), the export's files
      // (readyImages and isExportable), the status (find) and the staff's image (staffAccess).
      expect(methodsThatAre("reader")).toEqual(["fileAccess", "find", "forPosts", "isExportable", "readyImages", "staffAccess"]);
      for (const name of methodsThatAre("neither")) {
        const role = METHODS[name];
        expect(role.is === "neither" && role.why.length > 20, `${name}: ${role.is === "neither" ? role.why : ""}`).toBe(true);
      }
    });
  });

  describe("gate K: every deleter against a frozen post", () => {
    /** Each way a post comes to be frozen, with nothing else that would keep its rows: no hold stands on them. */
    const FREEZES: Record<string, (w: World, post: { postId: string; ownerId: string; handle: string }) => Promise<void>> = {
      "its own item": async (w, post) => {
        await suspectItemOn(w.tx, "post", post.postId);
      },
      "its author's account's item": async (w, post) => {
        await suspectItemOn(w.tx, "account", post.ownerId);
      },
      "an item korbat added for a post that quotes it": async (w, post) => {
        const quoting = await newPostRow(w.tx, (await newProfile(w.tx as unknown as Db)).id, { quoteOfId: post.postId });
        const named = await suspectItemOn(w.tx, "post", quoting);
        await insertItem(w.tx, { intakeId: named.intakeId, caseId: await openCase(w.tx, "post", post.postId), targetId: post.postId, position: 11, lane: 0 });
      },
      "a seal taken while deciding": async (w, post) => {
        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam");
        await decideIn(w.tx, mod, caseId, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING);
      },
      "a seal for good, whose case is closed": async (w, post) => {
        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam");
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
      },
    };

    test.each(Object.keys(FREEZES))("frozen through %s: each deleter leaves the rows, answers no id of them and no file of them is requested, before and after the author deleted the post", async (freeze) => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        await FREEZES[freeze]!(w, { postId: p.postId, ownerId: ada.id, handle: ada.handle });
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, p.postId)).toBe(true);
        // No hold stands on the rows: what keeps them is the freeze.
        expect(await w.tx.execute(sql`select 1 from media_holds where media_id = any(${uuids(p.mediaIds)})`)).toHaveLength(0);

        const frozen: Frozen = { repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds };
        for (const when of ["as posted", "deleted by its author"]) {
          if (when === "deleted by its author") await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
          for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
            const answered = await run(frozen);
            expect(answered.filter((id) => p.mediaIds.includes(id)), `${name}, ${when}`).toEqual([]);
            expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), `${name}, ${when}`).toEqual(sorted(p.mediaIds));
          }
        }
        // The account's upload on no post is reached by no case: the owner's purge took it.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [upload])).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => p.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("once nothing freezes the post any more, the same deleters take its rows", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const { caseId } = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await w.repo.detachAll(w.tx, p.postId)).toEqual([]);
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect(sorted(await w.repo.detachAll(w.tx, p.postId))).toEqual(sorted(p.mediaIds));
      });
    });

    test("a hold that is released on a frozen post's image frees nothing: the freeze keeps the row whether a hold stands or not", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.h.established();
        const p = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report about the post itself places its case's hold and freezes the post.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update media_holds set released_at = now() where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        const [row] = await w.tx.execute<{ held: boolean }>(sql`select hold_until is not null as held from post_media where id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(row).toEqual({ held: false });
        await authorDeletes(w.tx, p.postId);
        for (const [name, run] of Object.entries(DELETERS)) {
          await run({ repo: w.repo, tx: w.tx, ownerId: ada.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds });
          expect(await existing(w.tx, p.mediaIds), name).toEqual(p.mediaIds);
        }
      }, migrateDb);
    });
  });

  describe("gate K through the flows: the author's deletion, the purge, the sweeper and the reconcile pass", () => {
    /** Each kind of reach through a real report of child sexual abuse material; it answers nothing, the post is frozen. */
    const REPORTS: Record<string, (w: World, post: { postId: string; ownerId: string; handle: string }) => Promise<unknown>> = {
      "its own item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(post.postId), "csam"),
      "its author's account's item": (w, post) => report(w.tx, anAccount(post.ownerId, post.handle), "csam"),
      "an item korbat added for a post that quotes it": async (w, post) => report(w.tx, aPost(await newPostRow(w.tx, (await newProfile(w.tx as unknown as Db)).id, { quoteOfId: post.postId })), "csam"),
    };

    test.each(Object.keys(REPORTS))("a post frozen through %s: its rows outlive every flow that deletes, no file of them is requested, and no reader shows them once the post is deleted", async (kind) => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const frozen = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        await REPORTS[kind]!(w, { postId: frozen.postId, ownerId: ada.id, handle: ada.handle });
        // A case about the account reaches every post of the account, so there the other post's image is kept too.
        const kept = kind === "its author's account's item" ? [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds] : frozen.mediaIds;
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => kept.includes(id));

        // The author deletes the post, through the flow: the post is a tombstone, and its image rows stay.
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId);
        expect(await rejection(getPost(w.s.deps, ada.id, frozen.postId))).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // No reader shows a kept image of a deleted post, to its owner either, so the freeze tells the author nothing.
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) {
          for (const viewer of [ada.id, null]) expect((await ask(w, id, viewer)).kind, `serve ${String(viewer)}`).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.find(id)).toBeNull();
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await w.repo.isExportable(ada.id, id)).toBe(false);
        }
        expect((await w.repo.forPosts([frozen.postId])).size).toBe(0);
        expect(await w.repo.readyImages(ada.id)).toEqual([...free.mediaIds, upload]);
        // The reconcile pass asks which ids have a row: the kept rows are seen, so their files are no orphans.
        expect(await w.repo.existing(frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(new Set(frozen.mediaIds));

        // The export names no image under the deleted post, holds no file of it, and lists none as missing.
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`, `media/${upload}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === frozen.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", media: [] });
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === free.postId)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(free.mediaIds);
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);

        // The sweeper two days on, with its reconcile pass: every stored file is old by then, and none of the kept rows'
        // files is taken for an orphan.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, frozen.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(frozen.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The account is purged, by the request and then again by the job: the kept rows stay, unserved, and only the
        // files of the rows that went are requested.
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, [...frozen.mediaIds, ...free.mediaIds, upload])).toEqual(sorted(kept));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...free.mediaIds, upload].filter((id) => !kept.includes(id))));
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, frozen.postId)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a purge whose transaction does not commit has asked for no file: a report that then freezes the account keeps rows whose files nobody was told to delete, neither the rerun nor the sweeper asks for them, and a seal lists images that are still there", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => own.mediaIds.includes(id));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The first run deletes the rows, and its transaction does not commit: the process stops, or the connection is lost.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        // The rows are back, and no file of them was asked for: the worker deletes whatever a request names.
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // Before the purge job's next round, a report on the protected path about the account: every image is frozen.
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId)).toBe(true);
        // The job's rerun keeps the frozen rows and asks for nothing of them.
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0 });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper, which asks again for whatever a deleter still owes: a row that is still there is owed nothing,
        // at once or two days on, when the marker the failed run left is forgotten.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).filter((entry) => own.mediaIds.includes(entry.id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of own.mediaIds) expect(await w.h.files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(true);

        // An admin seals: the seal lists the rows, and their files are there for whoever they are released to.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const states = await w.tx.execute<{ moderation_state: string }>(sql`select moderation_state from post_media where id = any(${uuids(own.mediaIds)})`);
        expect(states.map((row) => row.moderation_state)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("a purge that commits and whose request for the files then fails still finishes: what it deleted stays owed, is counted as late, and the sweeper's next pass asks for exactly those files", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        const mine = [...own.mediaIds, upload];
        const requested = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const owed = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).map((entry) => entry.id).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The requests' directory cannot be written when the purge comes to ask.
        const failing: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          media: mediaForAccount({
            ...w.h.deps,
            files: {
              ...w.h.files,
              requestDeletion: async () => {
                throw new Error("EROFS: the uploads volume cannot be written");
              },
            },
          }),
        };
        await purge(failing, ada.id);
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await owed()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        // Ten minutes on, what is still owed counts among the late erasures of the staff's home screen.
        const drained = await mediaForCases(w.h.deps).overdueDeletions();
        const later = mediaForCases({ ...w.h.deps, now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 11 * 60_000) });
        expect((await later.overdueDeletions()) - drained).toBe(mine.length);

        // The sweeper's next pass, with the volume back: the files are asked for, and nothing is owed any more.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        expect(await owed()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await later.overdueDeletions()).toBe(drained);
      });
    });

    test("the account's purge end to end with open cases about it and a report it sent: a run that does not commit asks for nothing; the request's run and the job's keep what a case holds or a freeze keeps, ask for none of its files and forget her report; the cases then go on to their decisions, the disposal and the erasure of statements", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const second = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const other = await imagePost(w.tx, 0);
        // She reported someone else's post, signed in; someone reported a post of hers under a rule; and her account is
        // reported on the protected path. The take-down has marked her auth row.
        const hers = await intake(w.tx, ground.illegal(ada.id), aPost(other.postId));
        const rule = await report(w.tx, aPost(own.postId), "rule");
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        await authAccount(w.tx, ada.id, "0 seconds");
        const images = [...own.mediaIds, ...second.mediaIds];
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => images.includes(id));
        const base = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        const deps: typeof base = {
          ...base,
          moderation: { forgetAccount: async (userId) => void (await forgetReporter(w.tx, userId)), exportFor: () => Promise.reject(new Error("not exercised here")) },
        };

        // A first run whose transaction does not commit: nothing of it stands, and no file was asked for.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The request's run, and the job's after it.
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        const [profile] = await w.tx.execute<{ display_name: string; bio: string; deleted: boolean; handle: string }>(sql`select display_name, bio, deleted_at is not null as deleted, handle from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...profile! }).toEqual({ display_name: "Deleted account", bio: "", deleted: true, handle: ada.handle });
        expect([...(await w.tx.execute<{ state: string; body: string }>(sql`select state, body from posts where author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid`))].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
        ]);
        // Every image row stays (the freeze keeps them all, the rule case holds one), and none of their files was asked for.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(sorted(images));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([true, true]);
        // Her report no longer names her, on the notice or on its items.
        const [forgotten] = await w.tx.execute<{ intake: boolean; items: boolean }>(
          sql`select n.reporter_id is null as intake, (select bool_and(i.reporter_account_id is null) from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id) as items from intakes n where n.id = ${hers.intakeId}::uuid`,
        );
        expect({ ...forgotten! }).toEqual({ intake: true, items: true });

        // The rule case is decided on its copy: the removal changes nothing, the post being deleted, and says so.
        const removal = await decideIn(w.tx, mod, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
        expect((await actionsOf(w.tx, removal)).map((action) => [action.kind, action.no_effect])).toEqual([["remove", "deleted"]]);
        expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.tx as unknown as Db, removal))!.statement)[0]).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedPost);
        // Its mail finds nobody: the auth module answers no_address for an account that is gone.
        expect(await sendStatement({ apiDb: w.tx as unknown as Db, auth: { mailAccount: async () => "no_address" } as never }, removal)).toBe("no_address");

        // The admin answers the report about her account without a seal: the freeze ends, and the disposal takes the image
        // no case holds and keeps the one the rule case holds.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([false, false]);
        const gone = await w.cases.dropDisposable(w.tx);
        expect(gone.filter((id) => images.includes(id))).toEqual(second.mediaIds);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(own.mediaIds);

        // Thirteen months after her account was deleted, the removal's statement texts are due and erased.
        await ageCase(w.tx, rule.caseId, "13 months");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await dueStatements(w.tx, 12)).toContain(removal);
        expect(await eraseStatementTexts(w.tx, removal)).toBe(2);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a deleted post whose images a case holds, with no freeze: the same for every reader and for the export", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const held = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report under a rule: its case holds the post's images as evidence.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(held.postId), "rule");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, held.postId)).toBe(false);
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, held.postId);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of held.mediaIds) {
          expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
          expect(await rejection(status(w.h.deps, ada.id, id))).toBe("not_found");
        }
        const { entries, json } = await exportOf(w, ada.id);
        expect(entries).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${free.mediaIds[0]}.webp`].sort());
        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === held.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", media: [] });
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper's reconcile pass leaves the retained rows' files alone.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
      });
    });
  });

  describe("gates S and V: every reader, for a frozen post and for sealed images", () => {
    /** An author with an image post, a reply of their own with an image and a post Explore ranks, and a reader who follows them. */
    async function scene(w: World) {
      // Explore ranks as of a past this file has to itself, so no other suite's post is in the ranking read below.
      const asOf = new Date(Date.UTC(2019, 0, 10, 12));
      const [author, other, ...fans] = await accounts(w.tx as unknown as Db, asOf, 5);
      const top = await w.h.postWithImages(author!.id, 2);

    type Scene = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scene>>;
    type Listed = (MediaView | HiddenMedia)[] | undefined;

    /**
     * Every list a post's images are read through, each as the viewer gets it: the images of the named post in that list.
     * `signedIn` marks the lists only an account has; Following is read by the one who follows the author.
     */
    function lists(w: World, f: Scene): { name: string; images: string[]; signedIn?: boolean; onlyFor?: string; read: (viewer: string | null) => Promise<Listed> }[] {
      const top = [...f.top.mediaIds];
      const inItems = (items: { post: PostView }[], id: string) => items.find((item) => item.post.id === id)?.post.media;
      const inPosts = (items: PostView[], id: string) => items.find((post) => post.id === id)?.media;
      return [
        { name: "the single post", images: top, read: async (v) => (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId)).media },

        { name: "a thread's ancestor", images: top, read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.strangerReply, page)).ancestors as PostView[], f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a thread's reply", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await thread(w.s.deps, v, f.top.postId, page)).replies.items, f.reply) },
        { name: "the Latest timeline", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await latestTimeline(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the Following timeline", images: top, signedIn: true, onlyFor: f.other.id, read: async (v) => inItems((await followingTimeline(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "Explore", images: [f.rankedImage], read: async (v) => inItems((await explorePage(w.s.deps, v, page)).items, f.ranked) },
        { name: "the profile's posts", images: top, read: async (v) => inItems((await profilePosts(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "the profile's replies", images: [f.replyImage], read: async (v) => inPosts((await profileReplies(w.s.deps, v, f.author.handle, page)).items, f.reply) },
        { name: "likes", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await likedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "bookmarks", images: top, signedIn: true, read: async (v) => inPosts((await bookmarkedPosts(w.s.deps, v!, page)).items, f.top.postId) },
        { name: "a quote embed", images: top, read: async (v) => { const quote = (await getPost(w.s.deps, v, f.quoting)).quoteOf; return quote && "media" in quote ? quote.media : undefined; } },
      ];
    }
    /** Runs every list for every viewer it has, and hands each answer to `check`. */
    async function everyList(w: World, f: Scene, check: (answer: Listed, images: string[], viewer: string | null, label: string) => void) {
      for (const list of lists(w, f)) {
        for (const viewer of [f.author.id, f.other.id, null]) {
          if (viewer === null && list.signedIn) continue;
          if (list.onlyFor && viewer !== list.onlyFor) continue;
          check(await list.read(viewer), list.images, viewer, `${list.name}, read by ${viewer === f.author.id ? "the author" : viewer === null ? "nobody signed in" : "another account"}`);
        }
      }
    }

    for (const { id } of open) await decided(admin, id, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
  }

  test("the cut-off is the latest dispatch hour at or before the round's start, its marker names the cut-off's day and hour, and a round comes every ten minutes", () => {
    expect(cutoffOf(new Date("2026-10-04T07:00:00.000Z"), 7).toISOString()).toBe("2026-10-04T07:00:00.000Z");
    expect(cutoffOf(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"), 7).toISOString()).toBe("2026-10-03T07:00:00.000Z");
    expect(cutoffOf(new Date("2026-10-04T23:30:00.000Z"), 23).toISOString()).toBe("2026-10-04T23:00:00.000Z");
    expect(cutoffOf(new Date("2026-01-01T00:10:00.000Z"), 0).toISOString()).toBe("2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z");
    // The day before the first of a month, and of a year.
    expect(cutoffOf(new Date("2026-01-01T00:10:00.000Z"), 23).toISOString()).toBe("2025-12-31T23:00:00.000Z");
    expect(dispatchMarkerKey(new Date("2026-10-04T07:00:00.000Z"))).toBe("moderation-dispatched:2026-10-04T07");
    expect(DISPATCH_INTERVAL_MS).toBe(10 * MIN);
  });

  test("what is younger than 15 minutes is not yet the job's: an urgent item, a pending receipt and a pending statement are left to the request that made them, and are the round's sixteen minutes on", async () => {
    // The job's clock still agrees with the database's here; no later test can ask this.
    const image = await post(1);
    const report = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(image.postId)]));
    w.mailer.mode = "fail";
    const target = await post();
    const notice = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(target.postId)], { email: w.address() }));
    const statement = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    w.mailer.mode = "deliver";
    expect(await casesCalling(w.deps, jobNow())).toEqual([]);
    expect(await round()).toMatchObject({ urgent: "none", receipts: 0, statements: 0 });
    expect([await receiptOf(notice.ref), await authorMail(statement)]).toEqual(["pending", "pending"]);
    ahead(16 * MIN);
    expect(await casesCalling(w.deps, jobNow())).toEqual([report.caseId]);
    // The intake's own alert went 16 minutes ago: its window is over, and the round sends the alert again.
    expect(await round()).toMatchObject({ urgent: "sent", receipts: 1, statements: 1 });
    expect([await receiptOf(notice.ref), await authorMail(statement)]).toEqual(["sent", "sent"]);
    await closeOpenCases();
  });

  test("the daily release: a decision made after the cut-off waits for the next dispatch hour; then the outcome shows on the status page, the re-examination window runs, one update goes to the address with the receipt's page link, and the contact's day moves", async () => {
    const { postId } = await post();
    const email = w.address();
    const notice = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(postId)], { email, name: "Ada" }));
    expect(w.mailer.to(email, "notice_received")).toHaveLength(1);
    const pageLink = w.mailer.to(email, "notice_received")[0]!.data.pageUrl;
    await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    // A round before the next dispatch hour, with no marker yet: its release runs, and its cut-off lies about 22 hours
    // before the decision by the database's clock, so nothing of the decision is released or mailed.
    const early = await round(new MemoryJobLock(() => Date.now() + aheadMs));
    expect(early).toMatchObject({ released: 0, marked: true, daily: true, outcomeMails: 0 });
    expect(await itemRows(notice.ref)).toEqual([{ position: 1, outcome_mail: "pending", shown: null, released: false }]);
    expect((await status(notice)).items[0]).toMatchObject({ outcome: null, decidedOn: null, reexamination: null });
    expect(w.mailer.updatesTo(email)).toHaveLength(0);

    // The dispatch hour is moved after the day's release: the decisions made since are released at the new hour.
    toNextDispatch();
    const daily = await round();
    expect(daily.released).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(daily).toMatchObject({ marked: true, daily: true });
    expect(await itemRows(notice.ref)).toEqual([{ position: 1, outcome_mail: "sent", shown: "no_violation", released: true }]);
    // The status page and the mail tell the same at the same time.
    const shown = (await status(notice)).items[0]!;
    expect(shown).toMatchObject({ outcome: "no_violation", sealed: false, unseen: false, changed: false, reexamines: false, scope: null });
    expect(shown.reexamination).toMatchObject({ open: true });
    const updates = w.mailer.updatesTo(email);
    expect(updates).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(updates[0]!.data).toEqual({
      signedIn: false,
      // A moderator's decision to take no action, which can be re-examined; the post quotes nothing, so no scope follows.
      lines: [{ ref: notice.ref, item: 1, link: postLink(w.config.APP_ORIGIN, postId), outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}.`, reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: true, unseen: false, automatic: false }],
      receipts: [],
      // The same page link as the receipt carried, with the contact's mail token.
      pages: [{ ref: notice.ref, pageUrl: pageLink }],
    });
    // The contact was owed its outcome mail when the daily step ran: its day is six months from then.
    expect(Math.abs((await forgetAfter(await contactOf(notice.ref))) - appealDeadline(jobNow()).getTime())).toBeLessThan(5 * MIN);

    // A later round of the same day runs no release and sends nothing again.
    ahead(10 * MIN);
    expect(await round()).toMatchObject({ released: null, marked: true, daily: false, outcomeMails: 0 });
    expect(w.mailer.updatesTo(email)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("the queue-age alert: per lane the cases past its response time, and the cases that have held a measure taken while deciding for more than 24 hours, at most once a day", async () => {
    const waitingMails = () => w.mailer.sent.filter((mail) => mail.template === "moderation_waiting");
    await closeOpenCases();
    const first = await post();
    const report = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(first.postId)], { ruleId: "R3" }));
    const second = await post();
    const holding = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(second.postId)]));
    await decided(moderator, holding.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    // Nothing is past its time yet (the job's clock is still less than a day ahead of the database's), and the round sends no alert.
    expect(await waitingCases(w.apiDb, jobNow())).toEqual({ lanes: [], interim: 0 });
    const mailed = waitingMails().length;
    expect((await round()).waiting).toBe("none");
    // A day on, lane 1's case has waited more than its 24 hours; lane 2's seven days are not over, but its measure is a day old.
    ahead(25 * HOUR);
    expect((await round()).waiting).toBe("sent");
    expect(waitingMails().length).toBeGreaterThan(mailed);
    const data = waitingMails().at(-1)!.data;
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ lane1Count: "1", interimCount: "1" });
    expect(data.lane1Oldest).toMatch(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC$/);
    expect([data.lane0Count, data.lane2Count]).toEqual([undefined, undefined]);
    // Not again within the day.
    const told = waitingMails().length;
    ahead(10 * MIN);
    expect((await round()).waiting).toBe("throttled");
    expect(waitingMails()).toHaveLength(told);
    await decided(moderator, report.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    await decided(moderator, holding.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
  });

  test("an account's notices of illegality get one update through its account, signed in and without a page; a link that named nothing is a line of its own; a rule report and a report of child sexual abuse material get no mail, and their outcomes are released all the same", async () => {

    expect(await itemRows(rule.ref)).toEqual([{ position: 1, outcome_mail: "none", shown: "no_violation", released: true }]);
    expect((await itemRows(dead.ref)).map((row) => row.outcome_mail)).toEqual(["sent", "sent"]);

  test("receipts the cap folded ride in the next daily update with their page links, two of one day in one update and alone when nothing else is owed; two notices of one address make one update; a receipt and a statement that waited are sent by the round", async () => {
    const email = w.address();
    const posts = [await post(), await post(), await post()];
    const [one, two, three] = [
      await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(posts[0]!.postId)], { email })),
      await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(posts[1]!.postId)], { email })),
      await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(posts[2]!.postId)], { email })),
    ];
    // An address that is not confirmed gets one receipt in 24 hours.
    expect([await receiptOf(one.ref), await receiptOf(two.ref), await receiptOf(three.ref)]).toEqual(["sent", "folded", "folded"]);
    // A second address with a folded receipt, whose notices are about the post that stays undecided: it is owed no line.
    const alone = w.address();
    await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(posts[2]!.postId)], { email: alone }));
    const lonely = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(posts[2]!.postId)], { email: alone }));
    expect(await receiptOf(lonely.ref)).toBe("folded");
    // A round before the next dispatch day is not the daily one: a folded receipt goes only with its own notice's
    // lines, there are none, so neither address is mailed and every folded receipt stays folded.
    expect(await round()).toMatchObject({ released: null, marked: true, daily: false, outcomeMails: 0 });
    expect([w.mailer.updatesTo(email), w.mailer.updatesTo(alone)]).toEqual([[], []]);
    expect([await receiptOf(two.ref), await receiptOf(three.ref), await receiptOf(lonely.ref)]).toEqual(["folded", "folded", "folded"]);
    // A notice whose receipt the relay could not take, and a statement it could not take either: both wait.
    w.mailer.mode = "fail";
    const other = w.address();
    const held = await post();
    const waiting = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(held.postId)], { email: other }));
    const statement = await decided(moderator, waiting.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    expect(await receiptOf(waiting.ref)).toBe("pending");
    expect(await authorMail(statement)).toBe("pending");
    w.mailer.mode = "deliver";
    // The first two notices of the address are answered; the third stays open.
    await decided(moderator, one.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    await decided(moderator, two.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "not_evident" });

    toNextDispatch();
    const report = await round();
    expect(report.receipts).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(report.statements).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(await receiptOf(waiting.ref)).toBe("sent");
    expect(await authorMail(statement)).toBe("sent");
    expect(w.mailer.to(held.author.email, "moderation_decision")).toHaveLength(1);
    // One update for the address: the lines of its two answered notices, the two folded receipts, and a page paragraph
    // only for the notice whose receipt went out by itself.
    const updates = w.mailer.updatesTo(email);
    expect(updates).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(updates[0]!.data.lines.map((line) => line.ref)).toEqual([one.ref, two.ref]);
    expect(updates[0]!.data.receipts.map((receipt) => receipt.ref)).toEqual([two.ref, three.ref]);
    expect(updates[0]!.data.receipts[0]!.pageUrl).toMatch(new RegExp(`/notice/${two.ref}#t=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`));
    expect(updates[0]!.data.receipts[0]!.items).toBe(postLink(w.config.APP_ORIGIN, posts[1]!.postId));
    expect(updates[0]!.data.pages.map((page) => page.ref)).toEqual([one.ref]);
    expect(updates[0]!.data.termsUrl).toBe(`${w.config.APP_ORIGIN}/terms`);
    expect([await receiptOf(two.ref), await receiptOf(three.ref)]).toEqual(["sent", "sent"]);
    // The other address gets an update of its folded receipt alone.
    const single = w.mailer.updatesTo(alone);
    expect(single).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(single[0]!.data).toMatchObject({ lines: [], pages: [] });
    expect(single[0]!.data.receipts.map((receipt) => receipt.ref)).toEqual([lonely.ref]);
    expect(await receiptOf(lonely.ref)).toBe("sent");
    await closeOpenCases();
  });

  test("the outcome lines' words: a restriction of what was already not shown, a post that quotes another, an account, and a decision changed by corrections in part and then in full", async () => {
    const email = w.address();
    // A post another case had already removed: the notice's own removal changes nothing now.
    const hidden = await post();
    const earlier = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(hidden.postId)]));
    await decided(moderator, earlier.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const quoted = await post();
    const quoting = await post(0, { quoteOfId: quoted.postId });
    const named = await w.account();
    const two = await post(2);
    const images = (await w.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select m.id from post_media m where m.post_id = ${two.postId}::uuid order by m.position`)).map((row) => row.id);
    const notice = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(hidden.postId), postTarget(quoting.postId), accountTarget(named.handle), postTarget(two.postId)], { email }));
    const caseOf = (position: number) => notice.items.find((item) => item.position === position)!.case_id!;
    await decided(moderator, caseOf(1), { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
    await decided(moderator, caseOf(2), { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    await decided(moderator, caseOf(3), { kind: "final", outcome: "not_evident" });
    const removal = await decided(moderator, caseOf(4), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: images.map((id) => act("remove_media", id)) });
    // The named account changes its handle before the release: its line still shows the handle as the notice named it.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set handle = ${`r_${named.handle.slice(2)}`} where id = ${named.id}::uuid`);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into handle_history (handle_lower, profile_id, changed_at) values (${named.handle}, ${named.id}::uuid, now())`);
    toNextDispatch();
    await round();
    expect(lines(email).map((line) => line.outcome)).toEqual([
      `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.restricted_legal}. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`,
      `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`,
      `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`,
      // The rule in the wording of the rulebook the decision was made under; a post that quotes nothing has no scope.
      "access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content).",
    ]);
    expect(lines(email)[2]!.link).toBe(accountLink(w.config.APP_ORIGIN, named.handle));
    expect((await status(notice)).items.map((item) => item.scope)).toEqual([null, "quote", "account", null]);

    // One of the two images is given back: the item reads "reversed in part" from the next release, and is mailed again.
    await decided(moderator, caseOf(4), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, outcome: "partly_reversed", actions: [act("restore_media", images[0]!)] });
    expect((await status(notice)).items[3]).toMatchObject({ outcome: "restricted_rule", changed: false });
    toNextDispatch();
    await round();
    expect(lines(email)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ item: 4, outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`, changed: true, reexaminable: false, unseen: false })]);
    expect((await status(notice)).items[3]).toMatchObject({ outcome: "partly_reversed", changed: true });
    await decided(moderator, caseOf(4), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, actions: [act("restore_media", images[1]!)] });
    toNextDispatch();
    await round();
    expect(lines(email)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ item: 4, outcome: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`, changed: true })]);
    expect((await status(notice)).items[3]).toMatchObject({ outcome: "reversed", changed: true });
  });

  test("what the sender of another report reads after an admin's answer to a report of child sexual abuse material: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION in the mail's line and on the status page; about an account, the ordinary phrase with its scope, and the sealed phrase with the suspect scope after a seal", async () => {

    expect((await status(sealedNotice)).items[0]).toMatchObject({ outcome: "restricted_rule", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" });

    expect((await itemRows(suspect.ref))[0]!.outcome_mail).toBe("none");

  test("a rule report on a post frozen through its author's account's case, and one on a post whose images are sealed for good, each answered without action by a moderator, read UNSEEN_NO_ACTION on the status page; once the post is no longer frozen, the ordinary phrase", async () => {

    // A rule report sent signed out without a name or an address is owed no mail.

  });

  test("an account whose address stopped korbat's report mails still gets the statement of a decision about it, and neither a receipt nor an update of its reports; once it resumes them, its next update goes", async () => {
    const account = await w.account();
    // The stop came from the address itself, on the status page of a notice sent signed out with it.
    const target = await post();
    const signedOut = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(target.postId)], { email: account.email }));
    expect(await w.authForModeration.stopNotifier(await contactOf(signedOut.ref), tokenOf(account.email))).toBe(true);
    expect(await w.authForModeration.accountReportMailStopped(account.id)).toBe(true);
    const other = await post();
