```ts
  let w: DeciderWorld;
  let mod: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let beforeAuth: Record<string, number>;
  /** The profiles the tests committed, and the auth rows the migrator made for some of them. */
  const profilesMade: string[] = [];
  const authRowsMade: string[] = [];
  const log = pino({ level: "silent" });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    w = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    before = await moderationCounts(apiDb);
    beforeAuth = await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb);
    mod = await w.staff("moderator");
    admin = await w.staff("admin");
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, profilesMade);
      if (authRowsMade.length > 0) await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.users where id = any(${`{${authRowsMade.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    } finally {
      await w.close();
      await closeDb(apiDb);
    }
  });

  /** The media module's interface for cases over the API's pool, recording every batch the disposal takes and every request for files, in order. */
  function recordingMedia(onRequest?: (ids: readonly string[]) => Promise<void>): { media: MediaForCases; events: string[]; requested: string[][] } {
    const real = casesMedia(apiDb);
    const events: string[] = [];
    const requested: string[][] = [];
    const media: MediaForCases = {
      ...real,
      dropDisposable: async (tx) => {
        const ids = await real.dropDisposable(tx);
        events.push(`deleted ${ids.length}`);
        return ids;
      },
      requestDeletion: async (ids) => {
        events.push(`requested ${ids.length}`);
        requested.push([...ids]);
        await onRequest?.(ids);
      },
    };
    return { media, events, requested };
  }
  const round = (media: MediaForCases) => retentionRound({ apiDb, media, log });
  /** The retention rows of the audit log after a place, as the record holds them. */
  const retentionRows = async (after: number) =>
    [...(await apiDb.execute<{ place: number; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown>; step_up: unknown }>(
      sql`select chain_seq::int as place, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata, step_up from audit_log where action = ${RETENTION_ACTION} and chain_seq > ${after} order by chain_seq`,
    ))].map((row) => ({ ...row }));
  const head = async () => (await one<{ seq: number }>(apiDb, sql`select seq::int as seq from audit_head where id = 1`)).seq;
  /** A post with images whose author is committed and remembered for the clean-up. */
  async function post(images: number, authorId?: string) {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, images, authorId);
    if (!authorId) profilesMade.push(p.authorId);
    return p;
  }
  /** A report about the target by someone new, remembered for the clean-up. */
  async function reported(target: Parameters<typeof report>[1], by: Parameters<typeof report>[2] = "rule") {
    const made = await report(apiDb, target, by);
    const [sender] = await apiDb.execute<{ id: string | null }>(sql`select reporter_id as id from intakes where id = ${made.recorded.intakeId}::uuid`);
    if (sender?.id) profilesMade.push(sender.id);
    return made;
  }
  const authorDeletes = (postId: string, ago = "0 seconds") =>
    w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() - ${ago}::interval where id = ${postId}::uuid`);
  const decided = (outcome: Awaited<ReturnType<DeciderWorld["decideAs"]>>): string => {
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  const imagesLeft = async (ids: readonly string[]) => [...(await apiDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from post_media where id = any(${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) order by id`))].map((row) => row.id);

  test("the job runs every ten minutes under the lock job:moderation-retention, and skips a round another instance holds", async () => {
    expect(RETENTION_INTERVAL_MS).toBe(10 * 60_000);
    expect(RETENTION_JOB).toBe("moderation-retention");
    const lock = new MemoryJobLock();
    const job = createRetentionJob({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), log }, lock);
    await lock.acquire("job:moderation-retention", "other", 60_000);
    expect(await job.round()).toBe("skipped");
    await lock.release("job:moderation-retention", "other");
    expect(await job.round()).toBe("ran");
    expect(await lock.acquire("job:moderation-retention", "other", 1_000)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the disposal deletes 60 image rows in three committed batches of 25, 25 and 10, each with its audit row and its files requested before the next batch", async () => {
    expect(DISPOSAL_BATCH).toBe(25);
    // Whatever earlier rounds left disposable goes first, so the batches below are this test's own.
    await round(casesMedia(apiDb));
    const owner = await newProfile(apiDb);
    profilesMade.push(owner.id);
    const ids: string[] = [];
    for (let n = 0; n < 15; n++) {
      const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, owner.id);
      for (let position = 0; position < 4; position++) ids.push(await newImageRow(apiDb, owner.id, postId, position));
      await authorDeletes(postId);
    }
    const start = await head();
    /** What another session sees at each request: the batch's rows are gone and its audit row is in the record. */
    const seen: { gone: boolean; rows: number }[] = [];
    const { media, events, requested } = recordingMedia(async (batch) => {
      seen.push({ gone: (await imagesLeft(batch)).length === 0, rows: (await retentionRows(start)).length });
    });
    const report1 = await round(media);
    expect(report1.batches).toEqual([25, 25, 10]);
    expect(report1.failed).toBe(0);
    expect(events).toEqual(["deleted 25", "requested 25", "deleted 25", "requested 25", "deleted 10", "requested 10"]);
    expect(seen).toEqual([{ gone: true, rows: 1 }, { gone: true, rows: 2 }, { gone: true, rows: 3 }]);
    // The lowest ids first, each id requested once, and every one of the 60.
    expect(requested.flat()).toEqual([...ids].sort());
    expect(await imagesLeft(ids)).toEqual([]);
    expect((await retentionRows(start)).map((row) => [row.actor_id, row.target_type, row.target_id, row.metadata, row.step_up])).toEqual(
      [25, 25, 10].map((count) => ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", null, null, { step: "images", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count }, null]),
    );
    // A second round changes nothing and writes no audit row.
    const again = recordingMedia();
    expect(await round(again.media)).toEqual({ drafts: 0, cases: 0, intakes: 0, redactions: 0, statements: 0, accessLog: 0, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(again.requested).toEqual([]);
    expect(await head()).toBe(start + 3);
  });

  test("every row of the retention table through one round with the clock moved: evidence, the intake record, an R4 redaction of a deleted post of a purged account, statements, drafts, the access log and the kept images; the late counts before, and none after", async () => {
    let now = Date.now();
    let contactsLate = 0;
    const auth: AuthForModeration = { ...noAuthForModeration(), overdueContacts: async () => contactsLate } as AuthForModeration;
    const late = () => erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth, now: () => new Date(now) });
    const baseline = await late();

    // A notice of illegality answered without action 13 months ago, released and mailed then; a note, a draft, an access row.
    const q = await post(1);
    const quiet = await reported(aPost(q.postId), "illegal");
    decided(await w.decideAs(mod, quiet.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
    await saveText(apiDb, quiet.caseId, mod.id, "note", "a note on the case");
    const draft = await saveText(apiDb, quiet.caseId, mod.id, "facts", "a draft nobody confirmed");
    await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into case_access_log (staff_id, case_id, kind) values (${mod.id}::uuid, ${quiet.caseId}::uuid, 'case_opened')`);
    await releaseItems(w.migrateDb, quiet.recorded.intakeId);
    await ageCase(w.migrateDb, quiet.caseId, "13 months 3 days");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intakes set received_at = received_at - interval '13 months 3 days' where id = ${quiet.recorded.intakeId}::uuid`);
    // An R4 removal that became final a month ago; its author deleted the post, and the account was purged 13 months ago.
    const p = await post(2);
    const r4 = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
    const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, r4.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
    await authorDeletes(p.postId, "3 days");
    await ageCase(w.migrateDb, r4.caseId, "7 months");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months 2 days' where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
    await authAccount(w.migrateDb, p.authorId, "13 months 2 days");
    authRowsMade.push(p.authorId);
    // An image of a post deleted three days ago that no case ever held: the disposal is late with it.
    const junk = await post(1);
    await authorDeletes(junk.postId, "3 days");
    contactsLate = 4;

    now += ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS + 1;
    const lateBefore = await late();
    const more = (key: keyof typeof baseline) => lateBefore[key] - baseline[key];
    expect({ caseEvidence: more("caseEvidence"), intakeRecords: more("intakeRecords"), statements: more("statements"), redactions: more("redactions"), images: more("images"), drafts: more("drafts"), accessLog: more("accessLog"), contacts: lateBefore.contacts }).toEqual({
      caseEvidence: 2, intakeRecords: 1, statements: 1, redactions: 1, images: 1, drafts: 1, accessLog: 1, contacts: 4,
    });
    // Within the minute every reader is answered what was read last, whatever changed since; a minute later it is read again.
    contactsLate = 0;
    expect(await late()).toBe(lateBefore);

    const start = await head();
    const { media, requested } = recordingMedia();
    const done = await round(media);
    expect(done).toMatchObject({ cases: 2, intakes: 1, redactions: 1, statements: 1, batches: [3], failed: 0 });
    expect(done.drafts).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(done.accessLog).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    // The no-action case: snapshot, note and hold gone; its image stays, since its post does.
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, quiet.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 0, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft(q.mediaIds)).toEqual(q.mediaIds);
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from staff_texts where digest = ${draft}`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from case_access_log where case_id = ${quiet.caseId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    // The intake record: its words and its sender gone, its items kept.
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select explanation, reporter_id, erased_at is not null as erased, (select count(*)::int from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id and i.outcome = 'no_violation') as items from intakes n where id = ${quiet.recorded.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ explanation: null, reporter_id: null, erased: true, items: 1 });
    // The R4 removal: the post erased for good under its author's deletion, every copy gone, the statement's texts erased, the images deleted and their files requested.
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select body, state::text as state, moderation_level::text as level, erased_at is not null as erased from posts where id = ${p.postId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ body: "", state: "deleted_by_author", level: "removed", erased: true });
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select redacted_at is not null as redacted from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid`)).toEqual({ redacted: true });
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, r4.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 0, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from staff_texts where case_id = ${r4.caseId}::uuid and text is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft([...p.mediaIds, ...junk.mediaIds])).toEqual([]);
    expect(requested.flat().sort()).toEqual([...p.mediaIds, ...junk.mediaIds].sort());

    // Each step's audit row: the server's own, ids and counts only.
    const rows = await retentionRows(start);
    expect(rows.every((row) => row.actor_id === "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" && row.target_type === null && row.target_id === null && row.step_up === null)).toBe(true);
    for (const row of rows) expect(Object.keys(row.metadata).sort()).toEqual(["caseId", "count", "decisionId", "intakeId", "step"]);
    const named = (step: string, key: string, id: string) => rows.filter((row) => row.metadata.step === step && row.metadata[key] === id).map((row) => row.metadata);
    expect(named("case_evidence", "caseId", quiet.caseId)).toEqual([{ step: "case_evidence", caseId: quiet.caseId, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 }]);
    expect(named("case_evidence", "caseId", r4.caseId)).toEqual([{ step: "case_evidence", caseId: r4.caseId, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 }]);
    expect(named("intake_record", "intakeId", quiet.recorded.intakeId)).toEqual([{ step: "intake_record", caseId: null, intakeId: quiet.recorded.intakeId, decisionId: null, count: 2 }]);
    expect(named("redaction", "decisionId", removal)).toEqual([{ step: "redaction", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: removal, count: 1 }]);
    expect(named("statements", "decisionId", removal)).toEqual([{ step: "statements", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: removal, count: 2 }]);
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.metadata.step)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["drafts", "access_log", "images"]));
    // In the order of the steps: the drafts first, the images last.
    expect(rows[0]!.metadata.step).toBe("drafts");
    expect(rows.at(-1)!.metadata).toEqual({ step: "images", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 });

    // Nothing is late any more, and a second round changes nothing and writes nothing.
    now += ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS + 1;
    expect(await late()).toEqual({ ...baseline, contacts: 0 });
    const after = await head();
    expect(await round(casesMedia(apiDb))).toEqual({ drafts: 0, cases: 0, intakes: 0, redactions: 0, statements: 0, accessLog: 0, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(await head()).toBe(after);
  });

  test.each(["its author's account", "its author's purged account", "the post itself, by the item korbat adds for a quoted post"] as const)(
    "a closed case holding the images of a post its author then deleted, due while the post is frozen through %s: every step of a round leaves its snapshot and its image rows, its notes go and its holds are released, and no file is requested; after an answer without a seal the next round takes them",
    async (reach) => {
    const f = await post(2);
    const closed = await reported(aPost(f.postId));
    decided(await w.decideAs(mod, closed.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
    await saveText(apiDb, closed.caseId, mod.id, "note");
    await authorDeletes(f.postId, "3 days");
    await ageCase(w.migrateDb, closed.caseId, "3 days");
    // The report of child sexual abuse material that freezes the post: about its author's account (purged or not), or about
    // a post of someone else that quotes it, which brings an item of its own for the quoted post.
    let suspectCases: string[];
    if (reach.startsWith("the post")) {
      const quoter = await newProfile(apiDb);
      profilesMade.push(quoter.id);
      const quoting = await newPostRow(apiDb, quoter.id, { quoteOfId: f.postId });
      const made = await reported(aPost(quoting), "csam");
      suspectCases = made.recorded.items.map((item) => item.caseId!);
      expect(suspectCases).toHaveLength(2);
    } else {
      if (reach.includes("purged")) await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set display_name = 'Deleted account', bio = '', deleted_at = now() - interval '3 days' where id = ${f.authorId}::uuid`);
      suspectCases = [(await reported(anAccount(f.authorId), "csam")).caseId];
    }

    const first = recordingMedia();
    const start = await head();
    expect(await round(first.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 1, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, closed.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 1, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft(f.mediaIds)).toEqual([...f.mediaIds].sort());
    expect(first.requested).toEqual([]);
    expect((await retentionRows(start)).map((row) => row.metadata)).toEqual([{ step: "case_evidence", caseId: closed.caseId, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 }]);
    // The case holds only a snapshot of a frozen post now: it is no candidate, nothing is late, and a round leaves it alone.
    const counts = await erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth: noAuthForModeration(), now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 10 * ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS) });
    expect({ caseEvidence: counts.caseEvidence, images: counts.images }).toEqual({ caseEvidence: 0, images: 0 });
    expect(await round(first.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 0, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(first.requested).toEqual([]);

    // An admin answers the report without a seal: the freeze ends. Two days on, the answered cases' own evidence is due
    // too (the case of the post itself held the images for that long), and one round takes everything.
    for (const id of suspectCases) {
      decided(await w.decideAs(admin, id, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, id, "2 days");
    }
    const second = recordingMedia();
    expect(await round(second.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 1 + suspectCases.length, batches: [2], failed: 0 });
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, closed.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 0, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft(f.mediaIds)).toEqual([]);
    expect(second.requested.flat().sort()).toEqual([...f.mediaIds].sort());
    },
  );

  test("a row that raises is rolled back alone with no audit row, is logged with its step and its id, and never stops another row; the count of what is late names it", async () => {
    // A decision whose subject's profile says deleted 13 months ago while its auth row is live: the job names it, the database refuses it.
    const p = await post(0);
    const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
    const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }));
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months 2 days' where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
    await authAccount(w.migrateDb, p.authorId);
    authRowsMade.push(p.authorId);
    // And a draft of three days ago, which the same round still deletes.
    const draft = await saveText(apiDb, made.caseId, mod.id, "reason", "an old draft");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update staff_texts set created_at = now() - interval '3 days' where digest = ${draft}`);

    const lines: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
    const logging = pino({ level: "info" }, { write: (line: string) => void lines.push(JSON.parse(line) as Record<string, unknown>) });
    const start = await head();
    const done = await retentionRound({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), log: logging });
    expect(done).toMatchObject({ statements: 0, failed: 1 });
    expect(done.drafts).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    const failures = lines.filter((line) => line.level === 50);
    expect(failures).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(failures[0]).toMatchObject({ job: "moderation-retention", step: "statements", decisionId: removal });
    // No log line of the round carries an address, a handle or an account id.
    expect(JSON.stringify(lines)).not.toContain(p.authorId);
    expect((await retentionRows(start)).map((row) => row.metadata.step)).toEqual(["drafts"]);
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from staff_texts where case_id = ${made.caseId}::uuid and confirmed_at is not null and text is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 2 });
    const counts = await erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth: noAuthForModeration(), now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 20 * ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS) });
    expect(counts.statements).toBe(1);
    // The mark comes off the profile again, so that the rounds of the other tests are not held to this refusal.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = null where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
  });

  describe("MODERATION_RETENTION", () => {
    /** A lock that says which keys were asked for, and resolves when one is let go. */
    function watchedLock() {
      const inner = new MemoryJobLock();
      const asked: string[] = [];
      const released = new Map<string, () => void>();
      const lock: JobLock = {
        acquire: (key, token, ttlMs) => {
          asked.push(key);
          return inner.acquire(key, token, ttlMs);
        },
        refresh: (key, token, ttlMs) => inner.refresh(key, token, ttlMs),
        release: async (key, token) => {
          await inner.release(key, token);
          released.get(key)?.();
        },
      };
      const until = (key: string) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => released.set(key, resolve));
      return { lock, asked, until };
    }

    test.each(["off", "on"] as const)("%s: after ten minutes the dispatch job's round runs, and the retention job's only while the switch is on; off, the warning is logged and a due case keeps its snapshot and a due R4 decision's post its body", async (setting) => {
      const p = await post(0);
      const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, made.caseId, "7 months");
      const state = async () => ({
        ...(await one<{ body: string; redacted: boolean }>(apiDb, sql`select (select body from posts where id = ${p.postId}::uuid) as body, (select redacted_at is not null from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid) as redacted`)),
        snapshots: (await evidenceLeft(apiDb, made.caseId)).snapshots,
      });
      expect(await state()).toEqual({ body: "a post", redacted: false, snapshots: 1 });

      const warnings: string[] = [];
      const logger = pino({ level: "warn" }, { write: (line: string) => void warnings.push((JSON.parse(line) as { msg: string }).msg) });
      const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: noAuthForModeration(), social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), config: { ...loadConfig(), MODERATION_RETENTION: setting }, logger });
      const { lock, asked, until } = watchedLock();
      vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["setTimeout", "clearTimeout"] });
      let stop: () => void = () => undefined;
      try {
        stop = moderation.startJobs(lock);
        expect(warnings.filter((line) => line === RETENTION_OFF_WARNING)).toHaveLength(setting === "off" ? 1 : 0);
        expect(RETENTION_OFF_WARNING).toBe("moderation-retention: off (MODERATION_RETENTION)");
        const dispatched = until("job:moderation-dispatch");
        const retained = setting === "on" ? until("job:moderation-retention") : Promise.resolve();
        // Nothing runs before the ten minutes are over.
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(RETENTION_INTERVAL_MS - 1);
        expect(asked).toEqual([]);
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2);
        await Promise.all([dispatched, retained]);
      } finally {
        stop();
        vi.useRealTimers();
      }
      expect(asked).toContain("job:moderation-dispatch");
      expect(asked.includes("job:moderation-retention")).toBe(setting === "on");
      expect(await state()).toEqual(setting === "off" ? { body: "a post", redacted: false, snapshots: 1 } : { body: "", redacted: true, snapshots: 0 });
      // The author's decision screen: the copy while korbat holds it, and after the job's redaction the words of an R4 erasure.
      expect((await authorDecisionView({ apiDb }, p.authorId, removal)).content.kind).toBe(setting === "off" ? "post" : "r4_redacted");
      // What the switch held back is made up by a round once it is on again.
      if (setting === "off") {
        await round(casesMedia(apiDb));
        expect(await state()).toEqual({ body: "", redacted: true, snapshots: 0 });
      }
    });
  });

  describe("the purge's forgetting", () => {
    test("forgetAccount forgets the reports of an account the take-down marked deleted, changes nothing for a live one, and nothing when run again", async () => {
      const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: noAuthForModeration(), social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), config: loadConfig(), logger: log });
      const { user } = await newUserWithDevice(createAuthRepo(w.authDb));
      await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${user.id}::uuid, ${`r_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`}, 'Reporter')`);
      profilesMade.push(user.id);
      const p = await post(0);
      const recorded = await recordIntake(moderation.deps, { ground: ground.rule(user.id), live: [aPost(p.postId)] });
      const linked = () => one(apiDb, sql`select (select reporter_id from intakes where id = ${recorded.intakeId}::uuid) as intake, (select reporter_account_id from intake_items where id = ${recorded.items[0]!.id}::uuid) as item`);

      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: user.id, item: user.id });
      // The take-down's mark, as the auth role sets it; from then on the purge's step forgets the links.
      await w.authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() where id = ${user.id}::uuid and deleted_at is null`);
      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: null, item: null });
      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: null, item: null });
      // The report goes on: its item still waits in its case.
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where id = ${recorded.items[0]!.id}::uuid and outcome is null and case_id is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });
  });

  describe("the erasures' races", () => {
    /** A signed-out notice of illegality about a new post, answered without action and released `ago` ago: no account stands on its items. */
    async function releasedNotice(ago: string) {
      const p = await post(0);
      const recorded = await intake(apiDb, ground.illegal(null), aPost(p.postId));
      const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
      decided(await w.decideAs(mod, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
      await releaseItems(w.migrateDb, recorded.intakeId);
      await ageIntake(w.migrateDb, recorded.intakeId, ago);
      return { ...p, caseId, intakeId: recorded.intakeId, itemId: recorded.items[0]!.id };
    }
    /** The re-examination's item, as the intake transaction inserts it, in a new open case of the post. */
    const reexamine = (db: Parameters<typeof insertItem>[0], n: { intakeId: string; postId: string; itemId: string }, caseId: string, marker?: string) =>
      insertItem(db, { intakeId: n.intakeId, caseId, targetId: n.postId, lane: 1, reexaminesItemId: n.itemId, marker });
    const openCaseOf = async (postId: string) => (await one<{ id: string }>(apiDb, sql`insert into cases (target_type, target_id) values ('post', ${postId}::uuid) returning id`)).id;

    test("a re-examination that holds the intake first makes the erasure wait, and the erasure then finds the intake not due", async () => {
      const n = await releasedNotice("5 months");
      const caseId = await openCaseOf(n.postId);
      const marker = newMarker();
      let erasing: Promise<string | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        // The re-examination is inside its window, and its transaction holds the intake's row.
        await reexamine(tx, n, caseId);
        // Meanwhile the window runs out: without the new item the intake's record would be due.
        await ageIntake(w.migrateDb, n.intakeId, "8 months");
        erasing = refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.erase_intake(${n.intakeId}::uuid)`));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      });
      expect(await erasing).toBe("not_due");
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select erased_at is null as held, explanation is not null as words from intakes where id = ${n.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ held: true, words: true });
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where reexamines_item_id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });

    test("an erasure that holds the intake first makes the re-examination wait, and the re-examination is then refused: nothing is asked of an erased record", async () => {
      const n = await releasedNotice("8 months");
      const caseId = await openCaseOf(n.postId);
      const marker = newMarker();
      let asking: Promise<string | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.erase_intake(${n.intakeId}::uuid) as n`)).toMatchObject({ n: expect.any(Number) });
        // The item's release is dated forward again while the erasure is still open: by the clock alone the window
        // would be open, so only the erased record refuses the request.
        await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_sent_at = now() - interval '5 months' where id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`);
        asking = refusal(reexamine(apiDb, n, caseId, marker));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      });
      expect(await asking).toBe("reexamination_not_open");
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select erased_at is not null as erased from intakes where id = ${n.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ erased: true });
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where reexamines_item_id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from cases where id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
    });

    /** A post removed under R1 seven months ago: its restriction is final for its author, and its case's evidence is due. */
    async function dueRemoval() {
      const p = await post(1);
      const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, made.caseId, "7 months");
      return { ...p, caseId: made.caseId, removal };
    }
    const snapshotErased = async (caseId: string) => (await evidenceLeft(apiDb, caseId)).snapshots === 0;

    test("a correction that names the old snapshot and takes the case first commits before the erasure, which then erases the snapshot", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      const marker = newMarker();
      const release = gate();
      const held = gate();
      // Another session holds the post's row, which the correction's measure needs after it has taken the case.
      const holding = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from posts where id = ${r.postId}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
      await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into decision_actions (decision_id");
      const erasing = refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`));
      await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      release.open();
      await holding;
      const correction = decided(await correcting);
      expect(await erasing).toBeNull();
      // The correction committed naming a snapshot that was whole at its commit; the erasure came after it.
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select (select decided_at from decisions where id = ${correction}::uuid) <= (select erased_at from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid) as before`)).toEqual({ before: true });
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.caseId)).toBe(true);
    });

    test("an erasure that takes the case first erases the snapshot, and the correction that named it is refused: snapshot_erased", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      let correcting: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`);
        correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
        // The correction first saves its reason on the case, and that already waits for the erasure, which holds the case's row.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into staff_texts (case_id");
      });
      expect(await refusal(correcting)).toBe("snapshot_erased");
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.caseId)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });

    test("a correction that names a snapshot taken in the last day commits, and the erasure is refused: the case is not due for a day", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      const fresh = await one<{ id: string; digest: string }>(w.migrateDb, sql`
        insert into evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, body, salt, digest)
        select case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, body, salt, digest from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid returning id, digest`);
      expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`))).toBe("not_due");
      decided(await w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")], snapshotId: fresh.id, snapshotDigest: fresh.digest }));
      expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`))).toBe("not_due");
      expect((await evidenceLeft(apiDb, r.caseId)).snapshots).toBe(2);
    });

    /**
     * A post with one image and two closed cases. The earlier one removed the image under R1 eight months ago, and its copy
     * of the post was taken then. The later one removed the post under R4 seven months ago: that removal is final for its
     * author, so its redaction is due, and the earlier case's copy, taken before it, holds what it restricted.
     */
    async function dueRedaction() {
      const p = await post(1);
      const earlier = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const imageRemoval = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, earlier.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove_media", p.mediaIds[0]!)] }));
      const later = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, later.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, earlier.caseId, "8 months");
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, later.caseId, "7 months");
      return { ...p, earlier: earlier.caseId, imageRemoval, later: later.caseId, removal };
    }

    test("the R4 redaction takes every case whose copy it erases before it erases one: it waits for a transaction that holds an earlier case of the post, as a decision on that case does, and erases that case's copy only afterwards", async () => {
      const r = await dueRedaction();
      const marker = newMarker();
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      // A decision takes its case's row in this mode before it reads the copy it names.
      const holding = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from cases where id = ${r.earlier}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const redacting = one<{ changed: boolean }>(apiDb, sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.redact_r4_body(${r.removal}::uuid) as changed`);
      try {
        // The redaction either comes to wait, or ends without waiting: then it erased the earlier case's copy beside
        // whoever holds that case, and a decision in that place would commit naming a copy erased under it.
        const first = await Promise.race([
          untilBlocked(apiDb, marker).then(() => "waited" as const, () => "never waited" as const),
          redacting.then(() => "ended without waiting" as const, () => "ended without waiting" as const),
        ]);
        expect(first).toBe("waited");
        expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(false);
      } finally {
        release.open();
        await holding;
      }
      expect(await redacting).toEqual({ changed: true });
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(true);
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.later)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select redacted_at is not null as redacted from decisions where id = ${r.removal}::uuid`)).toEqual({ redacted: true });
    });

    test("a correction of an earlier case's decision that names a copy the R4 redaction is erasing waits for the redaction at that case and is refused before it commits: snapshot_erased", async () => {
      const r = await dueRedaction();
      let correcting: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${r.removal}::uuid) as changed`)).toEqual({ changed: true });
        correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.earlier, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.imageRemoval, actions: [act("restore_media", r.mediaIds[0]!)] });
        // The correction first saves its reason on the earlier case, and that already waits for the redaction, which holds
        // that case's row because it erases that case's copy. A redaction that held only its own case would let the
        // correction read the copy whole and commit naming it.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into");
      });
      expect(await refusal(correcting)).toBe("snapshot_erased");
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${r.earlier}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });
  });

  test("this file left no moderation row behind: what its tests committed is removed, and the moderation tables and the four auth tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, profilesMade);
    profilesMade.length = 0;
    // The two staff members' own rows go with the world; their decisions are gone with the cases above.
    expect(await moderationCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)).toEqual(beforeAuth);
  });
});
```

```ts
// takes longer than the five seconds a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

 * Revealing who sent a report or a notice (3c design, section 7.3), against the real database: each refusal before
 * anything is written, the access row and the audit row that commit together, the reason text the audit function
 * confirms, the day's limit, the identity read only after the commit, and the mail to every staff account. Each test runs
 * inside one transaction that is rolled back, with a made-up confirmation: the audit row it leads to is one audit-verify
 * would refuse, so it never commits. A reveal that commits is confirmed by a real key, in the HTTP suite. The file's last
 * test holds it to leaving no row behind.

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: revealing who sent a report", () => {

  let migrateDb: Db;

  let linked: string;

  async function counts(): Promise<Record<string, number>> {

                 (select count(*)::int from auth.notifier_suppressions) as notifier_suppressions, (select count(*)::int from auth.staff_personal_accounts) as staff_personal_accounts`,
    );

    await inWorld(async (tx) => {

      expect(await revealAs(deps, mod, second.items[0]!.id, (await savedReason(deps, mod, caseId)).digest)).toEqual({ handle: null, name: null });
      expect(await reveals(tx, mod.id)).toBe(2);
      await deps.background.settle();
      expect(mailed.map((message) => (message.template === "moderation_reveal" ? message.count : null)).sort()).toEqual([1, 2]);
    });
  });

  test("a reveal whose name cannot be read stays on the record and is mailed to every staff account all the same: the read's failure is the answer's alone, a server error", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const { deps, contacts, mailed } = world(tx);
      // A contact that no configured key opens: the auth module cannot read the name it holds.
      const unreadable = { ...deps, auth: { ...deps.auth, notifierName: async () => Promise.reject(new Error("no configured key opens this contact")) } };
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const contact = randomUUID();
      contacts.set(contact, { found: true, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: true, suppressed: false });
      const notice = await intake(tx, { ...ground.illegal(null), contactId: contact }, aPost(p.postId));
      const itemId = notice.items[0]!.id;
      const reason = await savedReason(unreadable, mod, notice.items[0]!.caseId!);

      const failure = await revealAs(unreadable, mod, itemId, reason.digest).then(
        () => null,
        (err: unknown) => err,
      );
      // No refusal of the module's own: the route answers it with a server error.
      expect(failure).toBeInstanceOf(Error);
      expect(failure).not.toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
      // The reveal is on the record: its access row, its audit row, and its reason confirmed.
      expect(await reveals(tx, mod.id)).toBe(1);
      expect((await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from audit_log where action = 'identity_revealed' and target_id = ${itemId}`))[0]!.n).toBe(1);
      expect(await confirmedAt(tx, reason.id)).toBe(true);
      // And every staff account is told of it.
      await unreadable.background.settle();
      expect(mailed).toEqual([{ template: "moderation_reveal", handle: await handleOf(tx, mod.id), at: expect.any(Date), count: 1, limit: 10 }]);
    });
  });

  test("each refusal comes before anything is written: an item that is none or has no case, a recused person, a source that names nobody, a reason that is not the person's own unused one on this case", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const { deps, contacts } = world(tx);
      const r = await reported(tx);
      const reason = await savedReason(deps, mod, r.caseId);
      const answers: Record<string, string | null> = {};

      // not_found: no such item; an item whose link named nothing live, which has no case.
      answers["no such item"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, randomUUID(), reason.digest));
      const [dead] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
        insert into intake_items (intake_id, case_id, target_type, target_id, position, lane, outcome)
        select intake_id, null, 'post', gen_random_uuid(), 2, 2, 'not_available' from intake_items where id = ${r.itemId}::uuid returning id`);
      answers["an item without a case"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, dead!.id, reason.digest));

      // staff_recused: the case's subject is an account linked to the person.
      await staffProfile(tx, { id: linked });
      const close = await reported(tx, linked);
      answers["a case whose subject is linked to the person"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, close.itemId, (await savedReason(deps, other, close.caseId)).digest));

      // reveal_refused: the path for child sexual abuse material, a finding, a reporter whose link is gone, a notifier
      // who gave no name, and a contact that is lost.
      const csam = await intake(tx, ground.csam(), aPost(r.postId));
      const finding = await intake(tx, ground.finding(other.id, "R1"), aPost(r.postId));
      const unnamed = randomUUID();
      contacts.set(unnamed, { found: true, named: false, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false });
      const withAddress = await intake(tx, { ...ground.illegal(null), contactId: unnamed }, aPost(r.postId));
      const lost = await intake(tx, { ...ground.illegal(null), contactId: randomUUID() }, aPost(r.postId));
      const nameless = await intake(tx, ground.illegal(null), aPost(r.postId));
      const gone = await reported(tx);
      await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set reporter_account_id = null where id = ${gone.itemId}::uuid`);
      answers["a notice on the path for child sexual abuse material"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, csam.items[0]!.id, reason.digest));
      answers["a moderator's finding"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, finding.items[0]!.id, reason.digest));
      answers["a notifier who gave an address and no name"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, withAddress.items[0]!.id, reason.digest));
      answers["a notifier whose contact is lost"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, lost.items[0]!.id, reason.digest));
      answers["a notifier who left no contact"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, nameless.items[0]!.id, reason.digest));
      answers["a reporter whose link is gone"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, gone.itemId, (await savedReason(deps, mod, gone.caseId)).digest));

      // text_not_found: a digest nobody saved; another person's reason; a text of another kind; a reason of another case.
      const salt = hex64();
      const note = await saveText(deps, sessionOf(mod), r.caseId, { kind: "note", text: "a note", salt, digest: await textDigest(salt, "a note") });
      const elsewhere = await reported(tx);
      answers["a digest nobody saved"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, hex64()));
      answers["another person's reason"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, (await savedReason(deps, other, r.caseId)).digest));
      answers["a note's digest"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, note.digest));
      answers["a reason saved on another case"] = await refusal(revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, (await savedReason(deps, mod, elsewhere.caseId)).digest));

      expect(answers).toEqual({
        "no such item": "not_found",
        "an item without a case": "not_found",
        "a case whose subject is linked to the person": "staff_recused",
        "a notice on the path for child sexual abuse material": "reveal_refused",
        "a moderator's finding": "reveal_refused",
        "a notifier who gave an address and no name": "reveal_refused",
        "a notifier whose contact is lost": "reveal_refused",
        "a notifier who left no contact": "reveal_refused",
        "a reporter whose link is gone": "reveal_refused",
        "a digest nobody saved": "text_not_found",
        "another person's reason": "text_not_found",
        "a note's digest": "text_not_found",
        "a reason saved on another case": "text_not_found",
      });
      expect((await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from case_access_log where kind = 'identity_revealed' and staff_id = any(${`{${mod.id},${other.id}}`}::uuid[])`))[0]!.n).toBe(0);
      expect((await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from audit_log where action = 'identity_revealed' and actor_id = ${mod.id}::uuid and target_id = ${r.itemId}`))[0]!.n).toBe(0);
      expect(await confirmedAt(tx, reason.id)).toBe(false);
      // Nothing above spent the reason: the reveal it was saved for still goes through.
      expect(await revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, reason.digest)).toEqual({ handle: r.reporter.handle, name: null });
    }, migrateDb);
  });

  test("one person reveals at most the day's limit of sources: the next is refused with nothing written, its reason left unconfirmed, while another staff account's is accepted", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const { deps, mailed } = world(tx);
      await tx.execute(sql`update moderation_limits set reveals_per_day = 2 where id = 1`);
      const items = [await reported(tx), await reported(tx), await reported(tx)];
      for (const r of items.slice(0, 2)) await revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, (await savedReason(deps, mod, r.caseId)).digest);
      const third = items[2]!;
      const reason = await savedReason(deps, mod, third.caseId);
      const { session, confirmed } = confirmation(mod, third.itemId, { reasonCategory: "other", reasonDigest: reason.digest });
      const refused = await reveal(deps, session, confirmed, { requestId: "req-limit" }).catch((err: unknown) => err as { code: string; status: number; retryAfterSeconds?: number });
      expect(refused).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429 });
      expect((refused as { retryAfterSeconds?: number }).retryAfterSeconds).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(await reveals(tx, mod.id)).toBe(2);
      expect(await confirmedAt(tx, reason.id)).toBe(false);
      // Another staff account has its own day.
      expect(await revealAs(deps, other, third.itemId, (await savedReason(deps, other, third.caseId)).digest)).toEqual({ handle: third.reporter.handle, name: null });
      await deps.background.settle();
      // Each mail gives the person's count that day and the limit.
      expect(mailed.map((message) => (message.template === "moderation_reveal" ? [message.count, message.limit] : null))).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([[1, 2], [2, 2]]));
      expect(mailed).toHaveLength(3);
    }, migrateDb);
  });

  test("a confirmation whose time has run out, and one whose key was revoked since, reveal nothing and write nothing; a mail no address took changes nothing", async () => {
    // A staff account of this test's own: its key is revoked for good on the auth side.
    const leaving = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, leaving);
      const { deps, mailed } = world(tx, { accepted: 0 });
      const r = await reported(tx);

      // The challenge expired before the transaction began: nothing is written, and no identity is answered.
      const lateReason = await savedReason(deps, mod, r.caseId);
      expect(await revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, lateReason.digest, "other", new Date(Date.now() - 1000))).toBe("late");
      expect(await reveals(tx, mod.id)).toBe(0);
      expect(await confirmedAt(tx, lateReason.id)).toBe(false);

      // The key no longer opens anything: the audit function refuses as the transaction's last statement, which undoes
      // the access row with it.
      const endedReason = await savedReason(deps, leaving, r.caseId);
      await authDb.execute(sql`update auth.staff_keys set revoked_at = now() where id = ${leaving.keyId}::uuid`);
      expect(await revealAs(deps, leaving, r.itemId, endedReason.digest)).toBe("ended");
      expect(await reveals(tx, leaving.id)).toBe(0);
      expect(await confirmedAt(tx, endedReason.id)).toBe(false);
      await deps.background.settle();
      expect(mailed).toEqual([]);

      // No address took the mail: the reveal stands and is answered all the same.
      expect(await revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, lateReason.digest)).toEqual({ handle: r.reporter.handle, name: null });
      await deps.background.settle();
      expect(mailed).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(await reveals(tx, mod.id)).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  test("the case answer offers nothing more than the summary before a reveal, and after it: the handle is in the reveal's answer alone", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const { deps } = world(tx);
      const r = await reported(tx);
      await revealAs(deps, mod, r.itemId, (await savedReason(deps, mod, r.caseId)).digest);
      const view = await readCase(deps, sessionOf(mod), r.caseId);
      expect(JSON.stringify(view)).not.toContain(r.reporter.handle);
      expect(view.items[0]!.source).toMatchObject({ kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A" });
      // The reason is confirmed: it is no draft any more.
      expect(view.drafts).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.staff_personal_accounts where staff_user_id = ${mod.id}::uuid`);
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { DrizzleQueryError } from "drizzle-orm";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { scrub } from "../src/lib/logger";

describe("scrub", () => {
  test("masks emails and IPs inside strings", () => {
    expect(scrub("user a.b+c@example.com from 203.0.113.9")).toBe("user [email] from [ip]");
    expect(scrub("v6 2001:db8:85a3::8a2e:370:7334 and ::1 and fe80::1")).toBe("v6 [ip] and [ip] and [ip]");
  });
  test("leaves timestamps alone", () => {
    expect(scrub("at 2026-09-03T10:30:45Z")).toBe("at 2026-09-03T10:30:45Z");
  });
  test("redacts secret-bearing keys regardless of value", () => {
    expect(scrub({ authorization: "Bearer abc", cookie: "s=1", password: "p", nested: { token: "t" } })).toEqual({
      authorization: "[redacted]",
      cookie: "[redacted]",
      password: "[redacted]",
      nested: { token: "[redacted]" },
    });
  });
  test("a phone number is redacted by its key, as is the `to` field the mailer and the verification provider carry", () => {
    expect(scrub({ phone: "+447911123456", to: "+447911123456", workflow: [{ channel: "sms", to: "+447911123456" }], nested: { Phone: "+447911123456" } })).toEqual({
      phone: "[redacted]",
      to: "[redacted]",
      workflow: [{ channel: "sms", to: "[redacted]" }],
      nested: { Phone: "[redacted]" },
    });
  });
  test("an Error's message and stack are both scrubbed", () => {
    const err = new Error("relay rejected bob@example.com from 203.0.113.9");
    const out = scrub(err) as { name: string; message: string; stack: string };
    expect(out.message).toBe("relay rejected [email] from [ip]");
    expect(out.stack).toContain("relay rejected [email] from [ip]");
    expect(out.stack).not.toContain("example.com");
  });
  test("a failed query is logged by its statement, the database's code, constraint and message, and never its parameters", () => {
    const statement = "insert into staff_texts (case_id, author_id, kind, text, salt, digest) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::staff_text_kind, $4, $5, $6) returning id";
    const text = ["a staff text that quotes a reporter", "on two lines"].join(String.fromCharCode(10));
    const salt = "0123456789abcdef".repeat(4);
    const cause = Object.assign(new Error('insert or update on table "staff_texts" violates foreign key constraint "staff_texts_case_id_cases_id_fk"'), {
      code: "23503",
      constraint_name: "staff_texts_case_id_cases_id_fk",
      parameters: ["9d3c0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "9d3c0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", "facts", text, salt, "digest-of-it"],
    });
    // As drizzle-orm builds it when the driver throws: its message holds the statement and then every parameter.
    const err = new DrizzleQueryError(statement, ["9d3c0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "9d3c0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", "facts", text, salt, "digest-of-it"], cause);
    expect(err.message).toContain(salt);
    const logged = JSON.stringify({ err: scrub(err) });
    for (const secret of [salt, "a staff text that quotes a reporter", "on two lines", "digest-of-it", "9d3c0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"]) expect(logged).not.toContain(secret);
    // The statement is scrubbed like any other text (its casts read as addresses to the IPv6 mask), and it names no value.
    expect(scrub(err)).toMatchObject({ name: "Error", message: expect.stringMatching(/^Failed query: insert into staff_texts .* returning id$/), code: "23503", constraint: "staff_texts_case_id_cases_id_fk", cause: cause.message });
    // The stack keeps where it was thrown.
    expect((scrub(err) as { stack: string }).stack).toMatch(/^Error: Failed query: insert into staff_texts/);
    expect((scrub(err) as { stack: string }).stack).toContain("logger.test.ts");
    // Any other error is logged as before.
    expect(scrub(new Error("params: are words here"))).toMatchObject({ message: "params: are words here" });
  });

  test("walks arrays and keeps non-strings", () => {
    expect(scrub({ n: 1, ok: true, list: ["x@y.io", 2] })).toEqual({ n: 1, ok: true, list: ["[email]", 2] });
  });
});
```

```ts
    // What the link does (the lockdown of the 1c design, section 7.6), before the owner opens it.
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/removes? (this|the) passkey/);
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/sign(s)? out every session/);
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/password/);
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/two-factor authentication/);
    expect(added.text).toMatch(/the day before/);
    expect(added.html).toContain("&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt; &quot;Work&quot; laptop");
    expect(added.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a /);
    expect(added.html).toContain(removeUrl);

    const removed = renderTemplate("passkey_removed", { name, time: "2026-09-25 11:00 UTC" });
    expect(removed.subject).toBe("A passkey was removed from your korbat account");
    expect(removed.text).toContain(name);
    expect(removed.text).toContain("2026-09-25 11:00 UTC");
    expect(removed.text).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
    expect(removed.html).toContain("&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt;");
    expect(removed.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a /);

    const suspect = renderTemplate("passkey_suspect", { name });
    expect(suspect.subject).toBe("A passkey on your korbat account was switched off");
    expect(suspect.text).toContain(name);
    expect(suspect.text).toMatch(/copy/);
    expect(suspect.text).toMatch(/switched (it|that passkey) off/);
    expect(suspect.text).toMatch(/remove it/i);
    expect(suspect.text).toMatch(/add a new one/);
    expect(suspect.text).not.toMatch(/https?:\/\//);
    expect(suspect.html).toContain("&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt;");
    expect(suspect.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a /);

  describe("the staff mails (3a design, section 7)", () => {
    const LAST = "korbat never puts a link in a staff email.";
    const name = `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)> "Blue" key`;

    /** Plain paragraphs with no link of any kind, the last one saying so; and a user-written name never becomes HTML. */
    function linkless(template: string, r: { text: string; html: string }) {
      expect(r.text, template).not.toMatch(/https?:|www\.|:\/\//);
      expect(r.html, template).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
      expect(r.text.trimEnd().split("\n\n").at(-1), template).toBe(LAST);

    test("staff_key_added names the key and the time, and tells the person to go to the operator if it was not them", () => {

      expect(r.subject).toBe("A staff key was added to your korbat staff account");
      expect(r.text).toBe(
        [
          `A staff key named "${name}" was registered for your korbat staff account at 2026-10-01 09:30 UTC. It can open the staff console.`,
          "If this was you, there is nothing to do. If not, tell the operator at once; they revoke the key with the staff command line.",
          LAST,
        ].join("\n\n") + "\n",
      );
      expect(r.html).toContain("&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt; &quot;Blue&quot; key");
      linkless("staff_key_added", r);
    });

      expect(r.subject).toBe("A staff session started on the korbat console");
      expect(r.text).toBe(
        [
          `A staff session was started on the korbat console at 2026-10-01 09:31 UTC with your staff key "${name}", from Firefox on Linux.`,
          "If this was you, there is nothing to do. If not, someone holds that key: tell the operator at once; they revoke it and every session it opened with the staff command line.",
          LAST,
        ].join("\n\n") + "\n",
      );
      linkless("staff_session_started", r);
    });

    test("staff_key_suspect says the key was switched off as a likely copy, and never sends the person to the app's Security screen", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("staff_key_suspect", { name });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("A staff key on your korbat staff account was switched off");
      expect(r.text).toBe(
        [
          `A use of your staff key "${name}" on the korbat console (a sign-in or a confirmation) looked like a copy of it, so korbat switched that key off and ended every staff session it opened. It can no longer open the console.`,
          "Ask the operator for a link to register a new key. If you did not use it just now, tell them so: someone else holds a copy of the key.",
          LAST,

    test("staff_keys_revoked lists the keys and the time", () => {

      expect(r.subject).toBe("Staff keys revoked on your korbat staff account");
      expect(r.text).toBe(
        [

          "If you expected this, there is nothing to do. If not, ask the operator why.",

    test("each staff mail needs its data", () => {
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_key_added", { name: "Blue key" })).toThrow(/time/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_key_added", { time: "2026-10-01 09:30 UTC" })).toThrow(/name/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_session_started", { name: "Blue key", time: "2026-10-01 09:31 UTC" })).toThrow(/browser/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_key_suspect", {})).toThrow(/name/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("staff_keys_revoked", { time: "2026-10-01 09:32 UTC" })).toThrow(/names/);

  describe("the moderation mails of reports and notices (3c design, section 7.15)", () => {
    const LAST_USER = "korbat staff never ask for your password or a code, and korbat does not read replies to this email.";
    const LAST_STAFF = "korbat never puts a link in a staff email.";
    const POST_LINK = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
    const ACCOUNT_LINK = "http://localhost:8081/u/ada";
    const received = { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", items: `${POST_LINK}, ${ACCOUNT_LINK}`, termsUrl: "http://localhost:8081/terms" };
    const paragraphs = (text: string) => text.trimEnd().split("\n\n");

    test("notice_received to a signed-out notifier: the reference, the time, the links, and the page with the mail token in its fragment", () => {
      const pageUrl = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
      const r = renderTemplate("notice_received", { ...received, pageUrl });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat received your report N-ABCDEFGH23");

        `To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: ${pageUrl}`,
        "How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: http://localhost:8081/terms.",
        LAST_USER,

        `korbat received your report N-ABCDEFGH23 at 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC. It names: ${POST_LINK}, ${ACCOUNT_LINK}.`,
        "A moderator decides each item that names something on korbat; a link that names nothing is answered automatically. You get one email with every decision, at most once a day.",
        "You can follow it in korbat under Settings, Cases, Your reports.",

      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    });

      const r = renderTemplate("notice_received", { ...received, explanation: "the notifier's own words", name: "Ada" });
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/the notifier's own words|Ada/);
    });

      const r = renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count: "3", oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC" });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: a case is waiting in the urgent lane");

        "3 cases in the urgent lane (child sexual abuse or exploitation, direct threats, violence, public security or self-harm) are waiting; the oldest since 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC.",
        "Open the staff console. Until the phone alerts of sub-project 3e, this email is the only alert.",

      ]);
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
      expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
      // One case reads as one: the only case is the oldest, so the sentence gives its time alone.
      const one = renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count: "1", oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC" });
      expect(one.subject).toBe("korbat: a case is waiting in the urgent lane");
      expect(paragraphs(one.text)).toEqual([
        "1 case in the urgent lane (child sexual abuse or exploitation, direct threats, violence, public security or self-harm) is waiting, since 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC.",
        "Open the staff console. Until the phone alerts of sub-project 3e, this email is the only alert.",
        LAST_STAFF,
      ]);
      for (const count of ["2", "10", "11", "21"]) {
        expect(renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count, oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC" }).text, count).toContain(`${count} cases in the urgent lane (child sexual abuse or exploitation, direct threats, violence, public security or self-harm) are waiting; the oldest since 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC.`);
      }
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { count: "3" })).toThrow(/oldest/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_urgent", { oldest: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC" })).toThrow(/count/);
    });

    test("moderation_reads names the staff account and the limit it reached, tells its holder what to do, and carries no link", () => {
      const r = renderTemplate("moderation_reads", { handle: "mod_anna", limit: "400" });
      expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: a staff account reached its daily case limit");
      expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
        "The staff account @mod_anna opened 400 different cases today and cannot open others until midnight UTC.",
        "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not open them, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
        "If that was not expected, ask them. The operator raises the limit with staff.js limits.",
        LAST_STAFF,
      ]);
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
      expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_reads", { handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/limit/);
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_reads", { limit: "400" })).toThrow(/handle/);
    });

    test("moderation_reveal names the staff account, the time, the day's count and the limit, never the case or who was revealed, and carries no link", () => {
      const data = { handle: "mod_anna", time: "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC", count: "3", limit: "10" };
      const r = renderTemplate("moderation_reveal", data);
      expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: a staff account revealed who sent a report");
      expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
        "The staff account @mod_anna revealed who sent a report or notice at 2026-10-04 06:59 UTC. That is 3 of the 10 reveals one staff account may make today (UTC).",
        "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not reveal it, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
        "The staff console's home screen lists every reveal of the last 30 days with its case. If this one was not expected, ask them; if their key may be in someone else's hands, the operator revokes it with staff.js revoke.",
        LAST_STAFF,
      ]);
      expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
      expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
      for (const key of Object.keys(data)) {
        const { [key]: _left, ...rest } = data as Record<string, string>;
        expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_reveal", rest), key).toThrow(new RegExp(key));
      }
      // Only what korbat generated: a name, a case or a reason handed over by mistake appears nowhere.
      const more = renderTemplate("moderation_reveal", { ...data, name: "Ada Lovelace", caseId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", reason: "the reason's own words" });
      expect(more.text).toBe(r.text);
    });
  });

  test("missing template data is a programming error", () => {
    expect(() => renderTemplate("sign_in_code", {})).toThrow(/code/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("passkey_added", { name: "Phone", deviceLabel: "Chrome on Windows", time: "2026-09-25 10:00 UTC" })).toThrow(/removeUrl/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("passkey_added", { deviceLabel: "Chrome on Windows", time: "2026-09-25 10:00 UTC", removeUrl: "http://localhost:8081/passkey-remove/abc" })).toThrow(/name/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("passkey_removed", { name: "Phone" })).toThrow(/time/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("passkey_suspect", {})).toThrow(/name/);
  });
  test("the memory mailer records messages and finds the latest code per address", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "222222" } });
    expect(mailer.sent).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("222222");
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("c@d.io")).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

### Replace `apps/api/test/media/files.test.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, statSync, symlinkSync, truncateSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MAX_VARIANT_BYTES, SNIFF_BYTES } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import { MediaError } from "../../src/media/context";
import { createMediaFiles } from "../../src/media/files";

const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-media-files-"));
afterAll(() => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));

async function volumes(storeDevice?: number) {
  const base = path.join(root, randomUUID());
  const files = createMediaFiles({ uploadsDir: path.join(base, "uploads"), storeDir: path.join(base, "store"), log: pino({ level: "silent" }), storeDevice });
  await files.prepare();
  for (const dir of [files.store.files, files.store.results, files.store.attempts, files.store.tmp]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return files;
}

/** A body that arrives in chunks and declares no length, like a chunked upload. */
function chunked(...chunks: (string | Uint8Array)[]): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {
  return new ReadableStream({
    start(controller) {
      for (const chunk of chunks) controller.enqueue(typeof chunk === "string" ? new TextEncoder().encode(chunk) : chunk);
      controller.close();
    },
  });
}
const accept = () => undefined;

describe("receiving an upload", () => {
  test("the body is streamed to tmp/ and only becomes an upload when committed", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    expect(await files.receive(id, chunked("hello ", "world"), 100, accept)).toBe(11);
    expect(readFileSync(files.uploads.part(id), "utf8")).toBe("hello world");
    expect(existsSync(files.uploads.upload(id))).toBe(false);
    await files.commit(id);
    expect(readFileSync(files.uploads.upload(id), "utf8")).toBe("hello world");
    expect(existsSync(files.uploads.part(id))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the first bytes are judged before anything is written", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    let seen = 0;
    let onDisk = true;
    const body = chunked(new Uint8Array(200).fill(1), new Uint8Array(200).fill(2), new Uint8Array(200).fill(3));
    await files.receive(id, body, 10_000, (head) => {
      seen = head.byteLength;
      onDisk = existsSync(files.uploads.part(id));
    });
    expect(seen).toBe(SNIFF_BYTES);
    expect(onDisk).toBe(false);
    expect(statSync(files.uploads.part(id)).size).toBe(600);
  });

  test("a refused head leaves no file behind", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    const refuse = () => {
      throw new MediaError("unsupported_media_type", 415);
    };
    await expect(files.receive(id, chunked("%PDF-1.7"), 100, refuse)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "unsupported_media_type", status: 415 });
    expect(readdirSync(files.uploads.tmp)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("an empty or missing body reaches the judge as zero bytes", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const heads: number[] = [];
    await files.receive(randomUUID(), chunked(), 100, (head) => void heads.push(head.byteLength));
    await files.receive(randomUUID(), null, 100, (head) => void heads.push(head.byteLength));
    expect(heads).toEqual([0, 0]);
  });

  test("bytes are counted as they arrive: one byte over the limit ends the upload and removes the file", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    const kib = new Uint8Array(1024);
    await expect(files.receive(id, chunked(kib, kib, kib, new Uint8Array(1)), 3 * 1024, accept)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "file_too_large", status: 413 });
    expect(readdirSync(files.uploads.tmp)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await files.receive(randomUUID(), chunked(kib, kib, kib), 3 * 1024, accept)).toBe(3 * 1024);
  });

  test("the same id cannot be received twice", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    await files.receive(id, chunked("a"), 100, accept);
    await expect(files.receive(id, chunked("b"), 100, accept)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "EEXIST" });
  });

  test("discarding removes an upload whether it was committed or not", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const [partial, complete] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    await files.receive(partial, chunked("a"), 100, accept);
    await files.receive(complete, chunked("b"), 100, accept);
    await files.commit(complete);
    await files.discardUpload(partial);
    await files.discardUpload(complete);
    await files.discardUpload(randomUUID());
    expect([...readdirSync(files.uploads.tmp), ...readdirSync(files.uploads.incoming)]).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("preparing again clears half-received bodies and keeps complete uploads", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const [partial, complete] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    await files.receive(partial, chunked("a"), 100, accept);
    await files.receive(complete, chunked("b"), 100, accept);
    await files.commit(complete);
    await files.prepare();
    expect(readdirSync(files.uploads.tmp)).toEqual([]);
    expect(readdirSync(files.uploads.incoming)).toEqual([complete]);
  });
});

describe("reading the store, which is not trusted", () => {
  const ready = (id: string) => ({ v: 1, id, status: "ready", width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3" });

  test("a result that follows the protocol is returned", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    expect(await files.readResult(id)).toBeNull();
    writeFileSync(files.store.result(id), JSON.stringify(ready(id)));
    expect(await files.readResult(id)).toEqual(ready(id));
  });

  test("anything else is ignored: not JSON, extra keys, another id, too large, a directory", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const [a, b, c, d, e] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID(), randomUUID(), randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    writeFileSync(files.store.result(a), "not json");
    writeFileSync(files.store.result(b), JSON.stringify({ ...ready(b), path: "/etc/passwd" }));
    writeFileSync(files.store.result(c), JSON.stringify(ready(randomUUID())));
    writeFileSync(files.store.result(d), JSON.stringify({ ...ready(d), blurhash: "x".repeat(40_000) }));
    mkdirSync(files.store.result(e));
    for (const id of [a, b, c, d, e]) expect(await files.readResult(id), id).toBeNull();
  });

  test("an image is opened with its size, and the caller gets a handle to stream", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    expect(await files.openImage(id, "large")).toBeNull();
    mkdirSync(files.store.imageDir(id), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(files.store.image(id, "large"), "webp-bytes");
    const stored = await files.openImage(id, "large");
    expect(stored?.size).toBe(10);
    expect(await stored!.handle.readFile("utf8")).toBe("webp-bytes");
    await stored!.handle.close();
  });

  test("a file on another device is refused: that is what a symlink out of the volume looks like", async () => {
    const files = await volumes(-1);
    const id = randomUUID();
    mkdirSync(files.store.imageDir(id), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(files.store.image(id, "large"), "webp-bytes");
    writeFileSync(files.store.result(id), JSON.stringify(ready(id)));
    expect(await files.openImage(id, "large")).toBeNull();
    expect(await files.readResult(id)).toBeNull();
  });

  test.skipIf(process.platform === "win32")("a symlink in place of an image is not followed", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    const secret = path.join(root, `${randomUUID()}.secret`);
    writeFileSync(secret, "DATABASE_URL=secret");
    mkdirSync(files.store.imageDir(id), { recursive: true });
    symlinkSync(secret, files.store.image(id, "large"));
    expect(await files.openImage(id, "large")).toBeNull();
  });

  test.skipIf(process.platform === "win32")("a FIFO in place of an image is refused at once instead of blocking a thread", { timeout: 5_000 }, async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    mkdirSync(files.store.imageDir(id), { recursive: true });
    execFileSync("mkfifo", [files.store.image(id, "large")]);
    expect(await files.openImage(id, "large")).toBeNull();
    expect(await files.readResult(id)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("an oversized image and a directory are refused", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const [big, dir] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    mkdirSync(files.store.imageDir(big), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(files.store.image(big, "small"), "");
    truncateSync(files.store.image(big, "small"), MAX_VARIANT_BYTES + 1);
    mkdirSync(files.store.image(dir, "small"), { recursive: true });
    expect(await files.openImage(big, "small")).toBeNull();
    expect(await files.openImage(dir, "small")).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("deletion requests and the sweeper's view", () => {
  test("a request is an empty file; it is withdrawn once nothing remains", async () => {
    const files = await volumes();
    const id = randomUUID();
    mkdirSync(files.store.imageDir(id), { recursive: true });
    await files.requestDeletion([id]);
    await files.requestDeletion([id]);
    expect(await files.deletionRequests()).toEqual([id]);
    expect(statSync(files.uploads.deletion(id)).size).toBe(0);
    expect(await files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(true);
    rmSync(files.store.imageDir(id), { recursive: true });
    expect(await files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(false);
    await files.withdrawDeletion(id);
    expect(await files.deletionRequests()).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a deletion that is owed is a marker the worker never reads: it is no request until one is written, it is listed with its age, and it is forgotten by id", async () => {
```
