```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MEASURES, MEASURE_KINDS, RETENTION, REVERSAL_KINDS, SEAL_DRAFTS, appealDeadline, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, RULEBOOKS, STATEMENT_WORDS, getRule, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "../src/index";

/**
 * The statement of reasons (3c design, section 10): one pure function renders it for the author's screen, the console's
 * preview and the mail, from the decision's data and the versions it was made under. These tests hold it to the six
 * elements of Article 17(3) of the Digital Services Act for every kind of decision, and to the design's sentences word
 * for word.
 */
const POST = { id: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36", createdAt: "2026-10-01T12:00:00.000Z" };
const POST_TIME = "2026-10-01 12:00 UTC";
const DECIDED = "2026-10-04T09:30:15.250Z";
const IMAGE = "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d";
const RESET_DECISION = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const NO_RESET = { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } as const;

const measure = (kind: MeasureKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["measures"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  noEffect: null,
  sealed: kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } : null,
  ...more,
});
const reversal = (kind: ReversalKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["reversals"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  ...NO_RESET,
  ...more,
});

/** A final removal of a post under R1, following a report: the plainest restricting decision. */
function statement(more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}): StatementInput {
  return {
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
    reason: "That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
    source: "report",
    decidedAt: DECIDED,
    post: POST,
    measures: [measure("remove")],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
    ...more,
  };
}

const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;
const text = (input: StatementInput) => statementParagraphs(input).join("\n");
const appeal = (decidedAt: string) => REDRESS_TEXTS[1].appeal.replace("{deadline}", `${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)} ${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(11, 16)} UTC`);

describe("statementParagraphs", () => {
  test("a final removal under a rule, paragraph by paragraph: what was done, where and how long, how it came to korbat, no automation, the rule as its version words it, the facts, the reason and the appeal", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toEqual([
      `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`,
      "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
      "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
      "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
      `It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
      "The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
      "korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
      appeal(DECIDED),
    ]);
    // The deadline is the appeal's own: six months after the decision, to the minute, in UTC.
    expect(text(statement())).toContain("until 2027-04-04 09:30 UTC");
  });

  test("a time is printed as the mails print one: the date and the minute, in UTC", () => {
    expect(text(statement({ post: { id: POST.id, createdAt: "2026-02-28T23:59:59.999Z" } }))).toContain("your post of 2026-02-28 23:59 UTC");
  });

  test("an old statement renders with the rulebook it was made under", () => {
    for (const version of [1, 2] as const) {
      for (const rule of RULEBOOKS[version]) {
        const out = text(statement({ ruleId: rule.id as StatementInput["ruleId"], rulesVersion: version }));
        expect(out, `${rule.id} v${version}`).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule ${rule.id}, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
      }
    }
    // R6 changed its title, R1 its text: version 1 keeps the old words.
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, or impersonation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 2 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, impersonation or coordinated manipulation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 2 }))).not.toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    // A version the package does not hold cannot be rendered as another one.
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ rulesVersion: 9 }))).toThrow(/rulebook/);
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ redressVersion: 9 }))).toThrow(/redress/);
  });

  test("a decision on the law names the law, never a rule, and says that it applies everywhere", () => {
    const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).", source: "notice" }));
    expect(out).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).");
    expect(out).toContain("korbat cannot restrict content for one country alone, so this applies everywhere, which is more than the law of a single country asks for.");
    expect(out).toContain("korbat decided this following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act.");
    expect(out.join("\n")).not.toMatch(/korbat rule R[1-6]/);
  });

  test("the source is one of three phrases", () => {
    expect(W.source).toEqual({
      notice: "following a notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act",
      report: "following a report by another user",
      own_initiative: "found by a moderator",
    });
    expect(text(statement({ source: "own_initiative" }))).toContain("What this decision is about was found by a moderator.");
    for (const source of ["notice", "report", "own_initiative"] as const) expect(text(statement({ source })), source).toContain(W.source[source]);
  });

  describe("the redress text follows the decision's own kind and outcome, never a later event", () => {
    test("an interim decision carries the interim text and no appeal", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat hid your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`);
      expect(out).toContain("This applies everywhere korbat is available, for as long as korbat decides the case.");
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
      expect(out.join("\n")).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision once");
    });

    test("a final restriction carries korbat's appeal with its deadline", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement()).at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
    });

    test("every other decision carries the text for a decision its author cannot appeal", () => {
      const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
      const others: StatementInput[] = [
        statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, ...NO_RESET }] }),
        statement({ outcome: "not_evident", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [] }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore_media")], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed }),
        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
      ];
      for (const input of others) expect(statementParagraphs(input).at(-1), `${input.kind} ${input.outcome}`).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });
  });

  test("every restricting decision carries the six elements of Article 17(3): each measure, kind, ground and rulebook version", () => {
    const grounds = [
      { ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R3" as const, legalReference: null },
      { ground: "illegal" as const, ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 130 of the criminal code." },
    ];
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final"] as const) {
      for (const measureKind of MEASURE_KINDS) {
        if (!MEASURES[measureKind][kind]) continue;
        for (const ground of grounds) {
          for (const rulesVersion of [1, 2]) {
            const account = MEASURES[measureKind].target === "display_name" || MEASURES[measureKind].target === "bio";
            const input = statement({ kind, ...ground, rulesVersion, post: account ? null : POST, measures: [measure(measureKind)] });
            const out = statementParagraphs(input);
            const label = `${kind} ${measureKind} ${ground.ground} v${rulesVersion}`;
            // (a) the restriction, where it applies and for how long.
            expect(out[0], label).toMatch(/^korbat (hid|removed|sealed|reset) /);
            expect(out, label).toContain(kind === "interim" ? W.scope.interim : W.scope.final);
            // (b) the facts, and whether the decision followed a notice or korbat's own finding.
            expect(out, label).toContain("The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.");
            expect(out, label).toContain("korbat decided this following a report by another user.");
            // (c) the use of automated means.
            expect(out, label).toContain(W.automation);
            // (d) and (e) the legal ground, or the rule, with its explanation: as a finding only for a final restriction
            // that seals nothing; while deciding, as what korbat is checking; for a seal, as what the step rests on.
            const rule = getRule("R3", rulesVersion)!;
            const seals = measureKind === "seal_media";
            if (ground.ground === "illegal") {
              expect(out, label).toContain(seals ? "This step rests on the law: Section 130 of the criminal code." : kind === "interim" ? "korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 130 of the criminal code." : "korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 130 of the criminal code.");
            } else {
              expect(out, label).toContain(`${seals ? "This step rests on" : kind === "interim" ? "korbat is checking this against" : "It breaks"} korbat rule R3, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
            }
            if (seals || kind === "interim") expect(out.join(" "), label).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal/);
            expect(out, label).toContain("korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.");
            // (f) redress.
            expect(out.at(-1)!.startsWith(kind === "interim" ? REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim : "You can appeal this decision once"), label).toBe(true);
            // One paragraph is one line, but for a staff text that holds line feeds of its own, and none is empty.
            for (const paragraph of out) expect(paragraph.trim().length, label).toBeGreaterThan(0);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  describe("what was done, for each measure", () => {
    test("a post and an image, while deciding and for good", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", measures: [measure("withhold_media")] }))[0]).toBe(`korbat hid one image of your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ measures: [measure("remove_media")] }))[0]).toBe(`korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`);
      // Several measures in one decision: one paragraph each, in the decision's order.
      const both = statementParagraphs(statement({ measures: [measure("remove"), measure("remove_media")] }));
      expect(both.slice(0, 2)).toEqual([`korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`, `korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`]);
    });

    test("a field reset says that the placeholder was written once and that the old value does not come back", () => {
      const name = statementParagraphs(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_display_name")] }));
      expect(name[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reset your display name. korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your display name again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.",
      );
      const bio = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio")] }));
      expect(bio[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reset your bio while it decides. korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your bio again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.",
      );
    });

    test("each noEffect sentence: another decision already holds it, the post or the account is deleted, the field already held the placeholder", () => {
      const first = (input: StatementInput) => statementParagraphs(input)[0];
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. Another decision already keeps this post from being shown, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove_media", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. Another decision already keeps this image from being shown, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ measures: [measure("remove", { noEffect: "deleted" })] }))).toBe(
        `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it. You had deleted this post, so this changes nothing anyone sees.`,
      );
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).toBe("korbat reset your bio. The field already held korbat's placeholder, so this changes nothing now.");
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_display_name", { noEffect: "deleted" })] }))).toBe("korbat reset your display name. Your account is deleted, so this changes nothing.");
      // A reset that changed nothing wrote no placeholder, so it does not say that it wrote one.
      expect(first(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio", { noEffect: "already" })] }))).not.toContain("wrote this placeholder once");
    });
  });

  describe("the ground is worded by what the decision is", () => {
    const r2 = getRule("R2", 2)!;
    const r5 = getRule("R5", 2)!;

    test("the words, each a constant", () => {
      expect(W.ground.sealRule("R2", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('This step rests on korbat rule R2, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.sealLaw("Section 184b.")).toBe("This step rests on the law: Section 184b.");
      expect(W.ground.checkingRule("R5", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('korbat is checking this against korbat rule R5, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.checkingLaw("Section 241.")).toBe("korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.breaks("R1", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('It breaks korbat rule R1, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.illegal("Section 241.")).toBe("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.restedOnRule("R1", "Title", "Text.")).toBe('That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "Title": Text.');
      expect(W.ground.restedOnLaw("Section 241.")).toBe("That decision rested on the law: Section 241.");
      expect(W.ground.referenceErased).toBe("its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.");
    });

    test("a seal, while deciding and for good, on a report alone: the step rests on rule R2, and nothing says that the rule is broken or the images illegal", () => {
      const sealing = (kind: "interim" | "final") =>
        statementParagraphs(statement({ kind, ruleId: "R2", facts: SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post, reason: kind === "interim" ? SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding : SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.final, source: "notice", measures: [measure("seal_media")] }));
      for (const kind of ["interim", "final"] as const) {
        const out = sealing(kind);
        expect(out, kind).toContain(`This step rests on korbat rule R2, "${r2.title}": ${r2.text}`);
        expect(out.join(" "), kind).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal|korbat is checking/);
      }
      // A seal in the category Protection of minors, on the law: the same, with the law.
      const law = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 184b of the criminal code.", source: "notice", measures: [measure("seal_media")] }));
      expect(law).toContain("This step rests on the law: Section 184b of the criminal code.");
      expect(law.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/found it illegal|korbat is checking/);
    });

    test("a decision taken while deciding that seals nothing says what korbat is checking, on a rule and on the law", () => {
      const rule = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ruleId: "R5", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(rule).toContain(`korbat is checking this against korbat rule R5, "${r5.title}": ${r5.text}`);
      const law = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).", source: "notice", measures: [measure("withhold")] }));
      expect(law).toContain("korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 241 of the criminal code (threats).");
      // Beside "while it decides", nothing states a finding.
      for (const out of [rule, law]) expect(out.join(" ")).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal/);
    });

    test("a final restriction that seals nothing states what korbat found", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241." }))).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 241.");
    });
  });

  describe("the seal's sentences", () => {
    const seal = (sealed: { posts: number; images: number; deletedImages: number }, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}) => measure("seal_media", { sealed, ...more });
    const sealing = (more: Partial<StatementInput>) => statement({ ruleId: "R2", facts: SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post, reason: SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding, source: "notice", ...more });

    test("on a post case, while deciding: the images of the post, with their number, and the interim redress", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 3, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (3 in all): nobody can see them, you included.`);
      expect(out).toContain(`The facts: ${SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post}`);
      expect(out).toContain(`korbat's reasons: ${SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.deciding}`);
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
      // Neither sentence of a seal for good (the rule's own text speaks of both, so they are looked for as whole paragraphs' parts).
      expect(out[0]).not.toContain(W.sealForGood);
      expect(out.at(-1)).not.toContain(W.sealAppeal);
    });

    test("on an account case: every image on the account's posts, with and without posts the author had deleted", () => {
      const live = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 4, images: 9, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(live[0]).toBe("korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (9 on 4 posts): nobody can see them, you included.");
      const kept = statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 4, images: 9, deletedImages: 2 })] }));
      expect(kept[0]).toBe(
        "korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (9 on 4 posts): nobody can see them, you included. 2 of them are on posts you had deleted, which korbat had kept under its terms (Your data).",
      );
    });

    test("for good: kept only for the authorities, and the appeal waits until they have assessed the images", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(sealing({ reason: SEAL_DRAFTS.reason.final, measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 })] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. They are kept only for the authorities korbat reports this to.`);
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(`${appeal(DECIDED)} An appeal of a seal waits until the authorities have assessed the images.`);
      const account = statementParagraphs(sealing({ post: null, measures: [seal({ posts: 2, images: 5, deletedImages: 1 })] }));
      expect(account[0]).toBe(
        "korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (5 on 2 posts): nobody can see them, you included. 1 of them is on a post you had deleted, which korbat had kept under its terms (Your data). They are kept only for the authorities korbat reports this to.",
      );
    });

    test("a seal that changed nothing says so: already sealed, or the post or the account deleted", () => {
      const first = (more: Partial<StatementInput>, noEffect: "already" | "deleted") => statementParagraphs(sealing({ kind: "interim", measures: [seal({ posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 }, { noEffect })], ...more }))[0];
      expect(first({}, "already")).toBe(
        `korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. Another decision already keeps these images sealed, so this changes nothing anyone sees now. It stays in force should that decision be reversed.`,
      );
      expect(first({}, "deleted")).toBe(`korbat sealed the images of your post of ${POST_TIME} (2 in all): nobody can see them, you included. You had deleted this post, so this changes nothing anyone sees.`);
      expect(first({ post: null }, "deleted")).toBe("korbat sealed every image it held on your posts at that time (2 on 1 post): nobody can see them, you included. Your account is deleted, so this changes nothing.");
    });

    test("a lifted seal", () => {
      const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R2" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The authority answered on 2 October 2026.", measures: [], reversals: [reversal("unseal_media")], reviewed }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe("korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed it.");
      expect(out[1]).toBe("korbat lifted the seal on these images. If an image is still not shown, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies.");
    });
  });

  describe("reversals and what ended", () => {
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    const correction = (more: Partial<StatementInput>) => statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The post is satire.", measures: [], reviewed, ...more });
    const FIELD = (field: string) => `korbat does not put back your ${field} as it was before the reset: set it again in Settings, Profile if you wish.`;
    const KEPT = `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days.`;
    const KEPT_R4 = `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days, unless korbat had already erased it under rule R4.`;

    test("a correction of a final decision renders that decision's rule from its own row and version, and its reason", () => {
      // The corrected decision was made under rulebook version 1: its rule reads as that version worded it.
      const out = statementParagraphs(correction({ reviewed: { ...reviewed, rulesVersion: 1 }, reversals: [reversal("restore")] }));
      expect(out).toEqual([
        "korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed it.",
        `Your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        `That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 1)!.text}`,
        "Why korbat changed it: The post is satire.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
      const part = statementParagraphs(correction({ outcome: "partly_reversed", reversals: [reversal("restore_media")] }));
      expect(part[0]).toBe("korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed part of it.");
      expect(part[1]).toBe(
        `One image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
      );
      // A corrected decision on the law renders its legal reference.
      const law = statementParagraphs(correction({ reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { ...reviewed, ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241." } }));
      expect(law).toContain("That decision rested on the law: Section 241.");
    });

    test("a correction of an interim decision lifts what was done while deciding", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(correction({ reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { ...reviewed, kind: "interim" } }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe("korbat lifted what it did while deciding on 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC.");
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });

    test("a review answers the appeal: kept, reversed in part or reversed", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The post was read again.", measures: [], reviewed }))).toEqual([
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and kept that decision.",
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        `That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
        "Why korbat kept it: The post was read again.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }))[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed that decision.",
      );
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore_media")], reviewed }))[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed part of that decision.",
      );
    });

    test("the field-restore sentence, with and without its 30-day sentence, and with the R4 form", () => {
      const lifted = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]>, kind: ReversalKind = "restore_bio") => statementParagraphs(correction({ post: null, reversals: [reversal(kind, { resetDecisionId: RESET_DECISION, ...more })] }))[1];
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: false })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT_R4}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R3" }, "restore_display_name")).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your display name. ${FIELD("display name")} ${KEPT}`);
    });

    test("a final no-action decision that ends measures taken while deciding names them, and nothing else it did", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(
        statement({
          outcome: "no_violation",
          ground: null,
          ruleId: null,
          facts: null,
          reason: null,
          measures: [],
          endedMeasures: [
            { kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, ...NO_RESET },
            { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: IMAGE, ...NO_RESET },
          ],
        }),
      );
      expect(out).toEqual([
        `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.withhold.label}, ${MEASURES.withhold_media.label}.`,
        "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
    });

    test("the field sentence after an interim reset ended by a closing decision, with and without its 30-day sentence, and none for a field the closing decision resets itself", () => {
      const ended = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["endedMeasures"][number]>, kind: MeasureKind = "reset_bio") => ({ kind, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: RESET_DECISION, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null, ...more });
      const closing = (endedMeasures: DecisionStatement["endedMeasures"], more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}) =>
        statementParagraphs(statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, post: null, measures: [], endedMeasures, ...more }));
      expect(closing([ended({})])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")}`);
      expect(closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true })])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`);
      expect(closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" })])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT_R4}`);
      // Two resets of two fields: one field sentence each.
      expect(closing([ended({}, "reset_display_name"), ended({ oldValueKept: true })])[0]).toBe(
        `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_display_name.label}, ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("display name")} ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`,
      );
      // The closing decision resets the bio itself: its own reset's sentences speak for the field, and no field sentence is added.
      const own = closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true })], { outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R6", facts: "f", reason: "r", measures: [measure("reset_bio")] });
      expect(own[0]).toContain("korbat reset your bio.");
      expect(own[1]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}.`);
      expect(own.join("\n")).not.toContain("korbat does not put back your bio");
    });

    test("a final decision that lifts a withhold taken while deciding and leaves the case open", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(
        `Your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
      );
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });
  });

  test("a review or a correction renders the reviewed decision's rule under the rulebook that decision was made under, whatever version its own row carries", () => {
    const [v1, v2] = [getRule("R6", 1)!, getRule("R6", 2)!];
    expect(v1.title).not.toBe(v2.title);
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R6" as const, rulesVersion: 1, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    const correction = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }));
    expect(correction).toContain(`That decision rested on korbat rule R6, "${v1.title}": ${v1.text}`);
    expect(correction.join(" ")).not.toContain(v2.title);
    const review = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed }));
    expect(review).toContain(`That decision rested on korbat rule R6, "${v1.title}": ${v1.text}`);
    // A reviewed decision made under the current rulebook reads the current wording.
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed: { ...reviewed, rulesVersion: 2 } }))).toContain(
      `That decision rested on korbat rule R6, "${v2.title}": ${v2.text}`,
    );
    // A rulebook this package does not hold is never rendered as another.
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed: { ...reviewed, rulesVersion: 99 } }))).toThrow();
  });

  test("a decision that does nothing, and a decision on the law whose reference was erased, each read one fixed sentence", () => {
    expect(W.noAction).toBe("korbat decided to take no action.");
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [] }))[0]).toBe("korbat decided to take no action.");
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: null }))).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.");
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "illegal" as const, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }))).toContain(
      "That decision rested on the law: its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.",
    );
  });

  test("every reversal kind has its sentence", () => {
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    for (const kind of REVERSAL_KINDS) {
      const account = MEASURES[kind].target === "display_name" || MEASURES[kind].target === "bio";
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, post: account ? null : POST, measures: [], reversals: [reversal(kind)], reviewed }));
      expect(out[1], kind).toMatch(/korbat lifted (this restriction|the seal on these images|the reset of your (display name|bio))\./);
    }
  });

  test("staff texts that were erased leave their paragraphs out, and the statement still stands", () => {
    const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ facts: null, reason: null }));
    expect(out.join("\n")).not.toMatch(/The facts:|korbat's reasons:/);
    expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
  });
});

describe("the package", () => {
  test("its index re-exports the statement and its words: the index is the package's only door", () => {
    expect(typeof statementParagraphs).toBe("function");
    expect(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation).toBe("No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/src/media/owed.ts`

```ts
import type { MediaDeps } from "./context";

/**
 * Deletions that are owed (3c design, sections 7.9 and 7.10, as the review of the built code corrected them). The
 * account's purge and the retention job's disposal delete image rows in a transaction and may ask the worker for the
 * files only after its commit: a row that came back with a failed commit can be frozen by a report the next moment, and
 * the worker deletes whatever a request names. Between the commit and the request the process can stop, and the request
 * itself can fail (a full or read-only uploads volume). So each of the two writes a note for every row it deletes,
 * inside its transaction (files.oweDeletion), and removes it once the request stands. What is left is retried here, by
 * one path for both: the sweeper calls it at every pass, and the disposal before it takes a new batch.
 *
 * A note says only that somebody meant to delete the row. The row decides: while it exists, nothing is asked of the
 * worker, however old the note is.
 */

/**
 * A note this old whose row is still there was written by a transaction that did not commit, and is forgotten. Far longer
 * than any transaction that deletes image rows stays open: a note is never forgotten while its transaction may still
 * commit, since the delete it stands for is not visible to this read until then.
 */
export const OWED_STALE_MS = 60 * 60_000;

/**
 * A deletion owed for longer than this counts among the late erasures of the staff's home screen: one round of the
 * retention job. A request normally follows its commit within the moment, and the sweeper retries every thirty seconds,
 * so one this old means that requests cannot be written.
 */
export const OWED_LATE_MS = 10 * 60_000;

export interface OwedReport {
  /** Requests written now for rows that are gone. */
  requested: number;
  /** Notes forgotten because their row is still there after an hour. */
  forgotten: number;
  /** Deletions still owed after this try: their rows are gone and their request could not be written. */
  owed: number;
}

/**
 * Writes the request for every owed deletion whose row is gone and removes its note; forgets the note of a row that is
 * still there once it is stale; and answers what it did and what is still owed. A row that is gone is gone for good (the
 * delete committed, or this read would still see it), so its files have no owner and the request is right whoever wrote
 * the note. A request that cannot be written is logged once for the pass, with the count and no id, and its notes stay.
 */
export async function requestOwed(deps: Pick<MediaDeps, "repo" | "files" | "log">, now: number): Promise<OwedReport> {
  const notes = await deps.files.owedDeletions(now);
  if (notes.length === 0) return { requested: 0, forgotten: 0, owed: 0 };
  const kept = await deps.repo.existing(notes.map((note) => note.id));
  const stale = notes.filter((note) => kept.has(note.id) && note.ageMs > OWED_STALE_MS).map((note) => note.id);
  const gone = notes.filter((note) => !kept.has(note.id)).map((note) => note.id);
  await deps.files.settleOwed(stale);
  if (gone.length === 0) return { requested: 0, forgotten: stale.length, owed: 0 };
  try {
    await deps.files.requestDeletion(gone);
    await deps.files.settleOwed(gone);
    return { requested: gone.length, forgotten: stale.length, owed: 0 };
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, owed: gone.length }, "media: the files of deleted images could not be requested; the requests stay owed and are tried again");
    return { requested: 0, forgotten: stale.length, owed: gone.length };
  }
}

/** How many deletions have been owed for longer than OWED_LATE_MS: rows that are gone whose files nobody could ask for. */
export async function owedLate(deps: Pick<MediaDeps, "repo" | "files">, now: number): Promise<number> {
  const old = (await deps.files.owedDeletions(now)).filter((note) => note.ageMs > OWED_LATE_MS).map((note) => note.id);
  if (old.length === 0) return 0;
  const kept = await deps.repo.existing(old);
  return old.filter((id) => !kept.has(id)).length;
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/statement-repo.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ActionKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { iso, rows, type Runner, type TargetType } from "./repo";

/**
 * The queries a statement of reasons is read from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10): the decision with its texts and the
 * decision it is about, its ledger rows, and the measures taken while deciding that ended with it. Every surface an
 * author reads a statement on (the decision's screen, the mail, the export, the answer to an appeal) is rendered from
 * these, so they are kept apart from the module's other queries: a test refuses the names of the tables of reports and
 * notices in this file, but for one pinned read in endedMeasures, which answers true or false of the case's own items.
 */

/** A decision as its statement is rendered from it, with what the mail and the staff alerts need beside it. */
export interface StatementDecisionRow {
  id: string;
  caseId: string;
  kind: "interim" | "final" | "review" | "correction";
  outcome: string;
  ground: string | null;
  ruleId: string | null;
  rulesVersion: number;
  redressVersion: number;
  source: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  suspect: boolean;
  authorMail: string;
  decidedBy: string;
  facts: string | null;
  reason: string | null;
  legalReference: string | null;
  targetType: TargetType;
  targetId: string;
  /** The post's creation time, which survives its deletion; null for an account case. */
  postCreatedAt: string | null;
  /** The account the decision is about: the post's author, or the account itself. */
  subjectId: string | null;
  /** The decision a review or a correction is about. */
  reviewed: { kind: "interim" | "final"; ground: string | null; ruleId: string | null; rulesVersion: number; legalReference: string | null; decidedAt: string } | null;
}

export async function statementDecision(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementDecisionRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, d.case_id, d.kind, d.outcome, d.ground, d.rule_id, d.rules_version, d.redress_version, d.source, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, d.suspect, d.author_mail, d.decided_by,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.facts_digest) as facts,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.reason_digest) as reason,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.legal_reference_digest) as legal_reference,
               c.target_type, c.target_id,
               (select ${iso("p.created_at")} from posts p where c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id) as post_created_at,
               case when c.target_type = 'post' then (select p.author_id from posts p where p.id = c.target_id) else c.target_id end as subject_id,
               r.kind as reviewed_kind, r.ground as reviewed_ground, r.rule_id as reviewed_rule, r.rules_version as reviewed_rules_version, ${iso("r.decided_at")} as reviewed_at,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = r.legal_reference_digest) as reviewed_legal
          from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id left join decisions r on r.id = d.reviews_decision_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: row.id as string,
    caseId: row.case_id as string,
    kind: row.kind as StatementDecisionRow["kind"],
    outcome: row.outcome as string,
    ground: row.ground as string | null,
    ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null,
    rulesVersion: row.rules_version as number,
    redressVersion: row.redress_version as number,
    source: row.source as string,
    decidedAt: row.decided_at as string,
    suspect: row.suspect as boolean,
    authorMail: row.author_mail as string,
    decidedBy: row.decided_by as string,
    facts: row.facts as string | null,
    reason: row.reason as string | null,
    legalReference: row.legal_reference as string | null,
    targetType: row.target_type as TargetType,
    targetId: row.target_id as string,
    postCreatedAt: row.post_created_at as string | null,
    subjectId: row.subject_id as string | null,
    reviewed:
      row.reviewed_kind === null
        ? null
        : { kind: row.reviewed_kind as "interim" | "final", ground: row.reviewed_ground as string | null, ruleId: row.reviewed_rule as string | null, rulesVersion: row.reviewed_rules_version as number, legalReference: row.reviewed_legal as string | null, decidedAt: row.reviewed_at as string },
  };
}

/** One ledger row of a decision as its statement tells of it: for a reversal the measure it lifts, for a seal what its list held. */
export interface StatementActionRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  noEffect: "already" | "deleted" | null;
  /** For a reversal: the decision that holds the lifted measure, its rule, whether that measure changed anything, and whether korbat still kept that decision's snapshot when this one was made. */
  lifted: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean } | null;
  sealedPosts: number;
  sealedImages: number;
  /** The seal's images on posts their author had deleted by the time it was recorded: nothing later is read. */
  sealedDeletedImages: number;
}

/** A decision's measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds. */
export async function statementActions(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementActionRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, a.no_effect, l.decision_id as lifted_decision, ld.rule_id as lifted_rule, l.no_effect as lifted_no_effect,
               (ls.erased_at is null or ls.erased_at > d.decided_at) as lifted_snapshot_kept,
               (select count(*)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_posts,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_images,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s join posts p on p.id = s.post_id
                 where s.action_id = a.id and p.state = 'deleted_by_author' and p.deleted_at <= a.created_at) as sealed_deleted
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
          left join decision_actions l on l.id = a.reverses_action_id
          left join decisions ld on ld.id = l.decision_id
          left join evidence_snapshots ls on ls.id = ld.snapshot_id
         where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid order by a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    kind: row.kind as ActionKind,
    mediaId: row.media_id as string | null,
    noEffect: row.no_effect as StatementActionRow["noEffect"],
    lifted: row.lifted_decision === null ? null : { decisionId: row.lifted_decision as string, ruleId: row.lifted_rule as string | null, noEffect: row.lifted_no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.lifted_snapshot_kept as boolean },
    sealedPosts: row.sealed_posts as number,
    sealedImages: row.sealed_images as number,
    sealedDeletedImages: row.sealed_deleted as number,
  }));
}

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with a final decision, without a reversal. */
export interface EndedMeasureRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  decisionId: string;
  ruleId: string | null;
  noEffect: string | null;
  snapshotKept: boolean;
}

/**
 * The measures taken while deciding that ended with this final decision, of those their author was told of: every one
 * that was still in force when the decision closed its case, and a seal taken while deciding whose suspect items the
 * decision answered, unless the decision itself seals (the images then stay sealed). It reads only what stood when the
 * decision was made: a reversal recorded later, or an item that arrived later, changes nothing here.
 */
export async function endedMeasures(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedMeasureRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, i.id as decision_id, i.rule_id, a.no_effect, (s.erased_at is null or s.erased_at > d.decided_at) as snapshot_kept
          from decisions d
          join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
          join decisions i on i.case_id = d.case_id and i.kind = 'interim' and i.decided_at < d.decided_at and i.author_mail <> 'none'
          join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = i.id
          join evidence_snapshots s on s.id = i.snapshot_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind = 'final'
           and a.kind in ('withhold', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id and r.created_at <= d.decided_at)
           and case when a.kind = 'seal_media'
                 then exists (select 1 from intake_items x where x.case_id = d.case_id and x.suspect and x.answered_by = d.id and x.created_at <= i.decided_at)
                      and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions own where own.decision_id = d.id and own.kind = 'seal_media')
                 else c.closed_at = d.decided_at end
         order by i.decided_at, a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind as ActionKind, mediaId: row.media_id as string | null, decisionId: row.decision_id as string, ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null, noEffect: row.no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.snapshot_kept as boolean }));
}
```

### Create `packages/db/migrations/0019_redaction_scope.sql`

```sql
-- The reach of the R4 redaction (3c design, section 6.4), corrected after the review of the built code. Written by hand:
-- this migration changes no table. It replaces redact_r4_body of migration 0018 (CREATE OR REPLACE keeps its owner and
-- its grants) in two places, and leaves everything else of it as it was:
--   * Which copies it erases (step 5), and which must be gone before it marks the decision (step 6): the snapshots of the
--     decision's target that were taken up to the decision, in whatever case they are. Those hold what the decision
--     restricted. A snapshot taken afterwards is a later look at the target: of an account it holds what the person wrote
--     since the reset, which the decision never judged; of a post it is the evidence of a case that was open then or was
--     opened later. 0018 erased those as well, an open and undecided case's among them, so that case's decision was then
--     refused on the copy its moderator had read, and a fresh copy held whatever the target had become. A later snapshot
--     goes by its own case's rule (erase_case_evidence), never by this function. Both times are the starts of their
--     transactions (the triggers of 0015 and 0016 stamp them), and a decision names a snapshot that was stored before
--     its own transaction began, so the copy a decision was taken on always lies before it.
--   * Its locks (step 2): after the profile and before the post it takes, in one statement and in id order, FOR UPDATE,
--     the decision's own case and every other case that holds a snapshot it is about to erase. 0018 took the decision's
--     case alone and erased other cases' snapshots without their locks, so a decision on one of those cases that had read
--     its snapshot whole committed naming a snapshot erased beside it. With the lock such a decision either commits
--     first, or waits at its case and is refused (snapshot_erased) before it stores anything. Every case taken here is
--     about one target, which has at most one open case; an intake takes at most that one, and a decision, an appeal and
--     an erasure take one case each, so no other transaction holds two of these rows and the order among them cannot
--     close a cycle. The place of the cases in the one lock order is unchanged: after profile rows, before the post.
-- The steps, as 0018 numbered them:
--   1. It refuses (invalid_decision) any decision that is not final, does not cite R4, or holds no removal of a post or
--      an image and no field reset.
--   2. Its locks, before it writes anything: for an account case the profile's row FOR NO KEY UPDATE; the cases named
--      above, in id order, FOR UPDATE; for a post case the post's row FOR UPDATE and then, in a statement of its own,
--      every image row of the post in id order FOR NO KEY UPDATE.
--   3. Then, each in a statement of its own: it refuses to run outside READ COMMITTED (read_committed_only); it refuses
--      (not_due) a decision that is not yet final for its author; and it changes nothing and answers false unless the
--      decision is not redacted yet and one of its R4 measures is in force. For a post case it also changes nothing and
--      answers false while the post is frozen.
--   4. For a post removal in force it blanks the post's body and marks the post erased; for an image removal in force it
--      marks that image erased. A mark that is already set keeps its time.
--   5. It erases, through the one function that erases a snapshot, every unerased snapshot of the decision's target
--      taken up to the decision, in this case and in any other.
--   6. It marks the decision redacted only when no unerased snapshot of that target taken up to the decision is left.
--      When the freeze began between step 3 and step 5, a snapshot was kept, the decision stays a candidate, and the
--      call after the freeze ends finishes it.
--   7. It releases the case's holds on the images it erased, and for a post case derives the post's level and its
--      images' states again.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."redact_r4_body"(decision_id uuid) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  d public.decisions;
  c public.cases;
  final_at timestamptz;
  redacted timestamptz;
  in_force boolean;
  removes boolean;
  frozen boolean;
  removed_images uuid[];
  released uuid[];
BEGIN
  -- 1.
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = redact_r4_body.decision_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR d.kind <> 'final' OR d.rule_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'R4'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions a
                     WHERE a.decision_id = d.id AND a.kind IN ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_bio', 'reset_display_name')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision';
  END IF;
  -- A decision's case, its time and a case's target never change, so this read before the locks names the right rows.
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = d.case_id;

  -- 2. A snapshot's time never changes either, and none can still appear that was taken before a decision this old, so
  -- the cases read here are the cases whose snapshots step 5 erases.
  IF c.target_type = 'account' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = c.target_id FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
  END IF;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cases k
    WHERE k.id = c.id
       OR k.id IN (SELECT s.case_id FROM public.evidence_snapshots s
                    WHERE s.target_type = c.target_type AND s.target_id = c.target_id
                      AND s.erased_at IS NULL AND s.taken_at <= d.decided_at)
    ORDER BY k.id FOR UPDATE;
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = c.target_id FOR UPDATE;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.post_id = c.target_id ORDER BY m.id FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
  END IF;

  -- 3.
  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'read_committed_only' USING ERRCODE = '25000';
  END IF;
  SELECT public.decision_final_at(d.id) INTO final_at;
  IF final_at IS NULL OR final_at > now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_due';
  END IF;
  SELECT x.redacted_at INTO redacted FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = d.id;
  IF redacted IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) > 0, coalesce(bool_or(f.kind = 'remove'), false), coalesce(array_agg(f.media_id) FILTER (WHERE f.kind = 'remove_media'), '{}'::uuid[])
    INTO in_force, removes, removed_images
    FROM public.measures_in_force f
   WHERE f.decision_id = d.id AND f.kind IN ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_bio', 'reset_display_name');
  IF NOT in_force THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    SELECT public.post_frozen(c.target_id) INTO frozen;
    IF frozen THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 4.
  released := removed_images;
  IF removes THEN
    UPDATE public.posts p SET body = '', erased_at = coalesce(p.erased_at, now()) WHERE p.id = c.target_id;
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(m.id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO released FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.post_id = c.target_id;
  END IF;
  IF cardinality(removed_images) > 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = coalesce(m.erased_at, now()) WHERE m.id = ANY(removed_images) AND m.post_id = c.target_id;
  END IF;

  -- 5. Only what was copied up to the decision: a later snapshot is another look at the target, and its case's own.
  PERFORM public.erase_snapshots(ARRAY(SELECT s.id FROM public.evidence_snapshots s
                                        WHERE s.target_type = c.target_type AND s.target_id = c.target_id
                                          AND s.erased_at IS NULL AND s.taken_at <= d.decided_at));

  -- 6.
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.evidence_snapshots s
                  WHERE s.target_type = c.target_type AND s.target_id = c.target_id
                    AND s.erased_at IS NULL AND s.taken_at <= d.decided_at) THEN
    UPDATE public.decisions x SET redacted_at = now() WHERE x.id = d.id;
  END IF;

  -- 7.
  PERFORM public.release_case_holds(c.id, released);
  IF c.target_type = 'post' THEN
    PERFORM public.moderation_apply(ARRAY[c.target_id], true);
  END IF;
  RETURN true;
END $$;
```

```json
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },
        "decisions_reversal_plain": {
          "name": "decisions_reversal_plain",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" not in ('review', 'correction') or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is null and \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null and \"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null and \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        }

        "intakes_ref": {

        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding'"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },
```

```ts
import {

  MEASURE_KINDS,

  SEAL_DRAFTS,
  compareDecisionActions,

  staffTextProblem,
  textDigest,
  type ActionKind,
  type CaseAppeal,
  type CaseDecision,
  type CaseDecisionAction,
  type CaseItem,
  type CaseSnapshot,
  type CaseView,
  type DecisionActionParams,
  type MeasureKind,
  type ReversalKind,
  type RuleId,
  type StaffMe,
  type StaffTextDraft,
  type TdbCategory,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_VERSION, RULES_VERSION, type StatementInput } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { StaffApi } from "./api";
import { codeOf, COMPOSER_WORDS, describeError, messageFor, NOTE_WORDS } from "./messages";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId } from "./router";
import { decideWithKey, reviewWithKey } from "./step-up";
import { normalised, saveStaffText, type RandomBytes } from "./texts";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The decision composer's pure parts (3c design, sections 7.5 and 8): what it offers to whom, the params it builds from
 * what the page shows, the statement it previews, and the confirmation by the key. The page builds every param itself,
 * from the case it displayed and from digests it computed, so what the key confirms is the console's own reading and
 * never a value an answer chose. The database checks every rule again; what is decided here is only what is offered.
 */

export type StaffRole = StaffMe["role"];

/** The texts a decision or a correction carries, by their kind. */
export const DRAFT_TEXT_KINDS = ["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason"] as const;
export type DraftTextKind = (typeof DRAFT_TEXT_KINDS)[number];

/** A text as it was saved on the case: its id, the text as saved, and the salt and digest the console drew and computed. */
export interface SavedText {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  salt: string;
  digest: string;
}

/**
 * The composer's draft for one case, which the store keeps across a sign-in by the same handle: the kind of decision,
 * what it decides and does, each text as its person typed it, and the texts already saved. A correction names the
 * decision it corrects, and its actions are reversals; a review names the decision whose appeal it answers, says which
 * of the three answers it gives (`review`), and its actions are reversals too; any other draft's are measures, and the
 * lifts of withholds taken while deciding.
 */
export interface CaseDraft {
  caseId: CaseId;
  kind: "interim" | "final" | "correction" | "review";
  reviewsDecisionId: string | null;
  /** A review's answer, as its person chose it: keep the decision, reverse part of it, or reverse it. */
  review?: AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"];
  outcome: "restricted" | "no_violation" | "not_evident";
  ground: "incompatible" | "illegal";
  ruleId: RuleId;
  category: TdbCategory;
  /** The checkbox of a decision on the law: terrorist content. */
  terrorist: boolean;
  actions: DecisionActionParams[];
  written: Record<DraftTextKind, string>;
  texts: Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, SavedText>>;
}

/** The composer's own sentences, each written once. The seal's drafts are the contracts', and the statement's words the rulebook package's. */
export const COMPOSER = {
  closed: "This case is closed. A new report about its target opens a new case; a restriction of this one that is still in force can be corrected.",
  adminFinal: "A final decision on this case, whatever its outcome, is an admin's.",
  unseen: "This post's images cannot be opened now. A report about an image that you answer now is answered unseen: its sender is told so and may ask again.",
  noEffect:
    "This changes nothing anyone sees now. It is recorded as a measure of its own, stays in force should the other restriction be reversed, and its author is told (not for a measure taken while deciding on a deleted post).",
  noteAdvicePost:
    "To record that you read a new urgent item, save your Art. 18 check as a note: a note saved after the item arrived ends its urgent-lane mails. A measure taken while deciding here changes nothing and mails its author at once.",
  noteAdviceAccount:
    "To record that you read a new urgent item, save your Art. 18 check as a note: a note saved after the item arrived ends its urgent-lane mails. Reset the display name or bio while deciding only when it carries what was reported: a reset mails its author at once.",
  onlySealEnds: "Only the seal, a recorded choice not to seal, or an admin's answer ends the urgent mails.",
  noteEnds: "To record that you read a new urgent item, save your Art. 18 check as a note: a note saved after the item arrived ends its urgent-lane mails.",
  neverWrite: "Never write that the images are child sexual abuse material: nobody at korbat has seen them.",
  declineWords:
    "Record why you do not seal now. This ends the urgent mails for the reports that have arrived so far, until an image is posted that this case reaches; an admin still answers the case. Every staff member sees this choice on the home screen for 30 days.",
  declined: "Your choice not to seal is recorded.",
  admin: {
    endsFreeze: "A final decision without a seal ends this case's freeze: staff may then open these images unless another open report or a seal still covers them, and every staff account is mailed.",
    unseen:
      "You decide without seeing the images. Seal for good, and report, when the report's words, the post's text or alt texts, or the account's conduct give a concrete reason to believe the report; answer without a seal when they give none. Say which it was in the facts.",
    answersEarlier: "Your answer also answers the reports on other grounds that arrived before the newest report of this kind, unseen; their senders are told so and may ask again.",
    afterwards:
      "After an answer without a seal the case's images may be opened: whoever is on duty opens the case's target the same day and, where an image breaks a rule or the law, opens a finding on the post and decides it (if it is what the report said, a finding citing R2, which freezes again). When a new report of this kind arrives before that decision is made, the admin's next answer carries the measure for what staff saw, and its facts say when the images were seen. An admin's answer never restricts under another rule on a report's words alone about an image nobody at korbat has opened: that report is answered unseen, and its sender may ask again.",
  },
  personalData: `${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.toAuthor}`,
  staysOpen: (throughSeq: number, left: number) =>
    `This decision answers the items up to the newest report of child sexual abuse material (item ${throughSeq}). The reports on other grounds that arrived after it stay open (${left} ${left === 1 ? "item" : "items"}), to be judged with the images once the freeze has ended.`,
  sealInError: "Lift a seal taken while deciding only when it was taken in error: on the wrong case, or on a report that gives no reason to believe it.",
  sealForGood:
```
